Large language models and AI agents are increasingly used to support biomedical research, but native model outputs may omit key analytical steps, misuse methods, or overstate conclusions. We evaluated whether autonomous access to a medical research skill package was associated with higher-quality AI-generated transcriptomic research-analysis outputs compared with native AI without skills. Methods. We conducted an exploratory multi-model human evaluation using a non-small cell lung cancer immunotherapy biomarker task. Six model backbones were tested. The evaluation included 21 anonymized outputs: 9 native-AI outputs and 12 skill-augmented outputs generated through an AI agent implementation represented by OpenClaw. Four non-expert biomedical reviewers and two blinded experts evaluated each output, with two ratings from each reviewer type. The primary outcome was expert-rated overall quality. Results. Skill-augmented outputs showed directionally higher expert overall quality than native-AI outputs (mean 5.50 vs 5.11; difference=0.39; bootstrap 95\% CI, -0.04 to 0.90; Welch p=0.156). Non-expert reviewer quality showed the same direction (mean 4.72 vs 4.47; difference=0.26; bootstrap 95\% CI, -0.25 to 0.80; Welch p=0.373). Expert agreement was limited (single-rating ICC=-0.15), and model-specific effects were descriptive and heterogeneous. Conclusions. Autonomous skill access showed a directional quality signal in this exploratory sample, but the signal was smaller than expert-rating noise and should not be interpreted as confirmatory evidence. The findings primarily motivate larger evaluations of skill-augmented AI agents with stronger reliability controls, platform replication, and biological-validity assessment.

AI.tldr: 这是一项探索性多模型人类评估研究,比较了"原生AI"与"技能增强型AI智能体"在NSCLC免疫治疗生物标志物转录组研究分析任务中的输出质量。结果显示技能增强输出在专家和非专家评分上均呈现方向性优势,但差异小于评分者间噪声,不具备确认性证据效力。
AI.motivation: 原生大语言模型在生物医学研究分析中存在遗漏关键分析步骤、方法误用和过度解读等问题。基于可重用技能的AI智能体有望改善输出质量,但缺乏跨模型的人工评估证据,尤其在转录组生物标志物研究这种需要整合证据、协议设计、数据分析、验证和生物学解释的复杂工作流中。
AI.method: 采用探索性多模型对比设计,使用NSCLC免疫治疗生物标志物构建任务(融合铁死亡、铜死亡、焦亡等程序性细胞死亡机制)。测试6个模型骨干(GPT-5.4、Claude Sonnet 4.6、GLM-5.1、DeepSeek-V4 Pro、Kimi K2.6、MiniMax-M2.7)。21份匿名输出(9份原生AI + 12份技能增强,后者通过OpenClaw平台实现)。由4名非专家生物医学审稿人和2名盲法专家按7点Likert量表评分,主要终点为专家总体质量。统计方法包括Welch t检验、Mann-Whitney U检验、自助法95%置信区间和ICC评估评分者一致性。
AI.result: 技能增强输出在专家总体质量上呈方向性优势(均值5.50 vs 5.11,差异=0.39,自助95%CI: -0.04至0.90,Welch p=0.156),非专家评分方向一致(4.72 vs 4.47)。专家方法学质量差异更显著(0.47,95%CI: 0.12至0.95)。但专家评分一致性极低(单项ICC=-0.15),专家间平均绝对差异(0.67)大于技能效应本身。模型层面效应异质:GPT-5.4获益最大(+1.25),GLM-5.1次之(+0.50),Kimi K2.6非专家偏好显著但专家中性,Claude Sonnet 4.6甚至略有下降(-0.25)。
AI.conclusion: 自主技能访问在探索性样本中产生方向性质量信号,但效应小于专家评分噪声,不应作为确认性证据解读。模型间效应异质性表明技能增强的价值取决于基础模型能力,且智能体平台、编排行为与技能包本身的效果无法分离。研究主要意义在于建立生物医学工作流级评估框架,并提示未来研究需要更强的评分可靠性控制、平台可复现性和生物学效度验证。该研究未评估所提出生物标志物的生物学合理性或临床有效性。

title: StatefulDiscovery: Evidence-Calibrated Claim Formation in Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
summary: Open-ended scientific discovery asks agents to move beyond executing analyses for predefined questions. Across multiple rounds of exploration, a discovery agent must decide which phenomena warrant investigation while avoiding overinterpretation, where emerging claims exceed the evidential scope of the analyses supporting them. This creates an evidence-calibration problem: the exploration trajectory must be coupled with claim status so that evidence can guide both what to investigate next and what can be claimed. We introduce StatefulDiscovery, a discovery framework that externalizes investigation state and uses it to coordinate frontier selection, evidence acquisition, and claim adjudication. We evaluate StatefulDiscovery across 40 real-data discovery tasks. Compared with several baselines, StatefulDiscovery produces more claims overall judged to be both well-supported and high-value. Ablations indicate that structured hypotheses, local adjudication, and frontier control contribute to performance. Together, these results suggest that explicit discovery state can couple exploration with evidence-calibrated claim formation.

AI.tldr: 提出 StatefulDiscovery 框架，通过外部化探索状态来协调科学发现中的前沿选择、证据获取与主张判定，在 40 个真实数据发现任务上产生更多有据可依且高价值的主张。
AI.motivation: 开放式科学发现中，智能体需要自主决定探索哪些现象并形成主张，但容易出现过度解读（emerging claims 超出证据支持范围）的问题。需要将探索轨迹与主张状态耦合，使证据同时指导下一步探索与可声称的结论。
AI.method: StatefulDiscovery 框架，将调查状态（investigation state）外部化，并用其协调三个环节：1）前沿选择（frontier selection）；2）证据获取（evidence acquisition）；3）主张判定（claim adjudication）。通过结构化假设（structured hypotheses）进行局部判定（local adjudication）并控制探索前沿。
AI.result: 在 40 个真实数据发现任务上，StatefulDiscovery 相比多个基线产生了更多被判定为"证据充分且高价值"的主张。消融实验显示结构化假设、局部判定、前沿控制三个组件均对性能有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 显式的发现状态（explicit discovery state）能够将探索与基于证据的主张形成耦合，为开放式科学发现中的证据校准提供有效方案。

title: AutoMine Solution for AV2 2026 Scenario Mining Challenge
comment: CVPR 2026 Scenario Mining Challenge (Temporal Track Winners)
summary: With the development of autonomous driving systems, mining high-value, safety-critical, and planning-relevant scenarios from large-scale driving logs has become essential for data-driven evaluation. In this paper, we propose AutoMine, a robust self-refining scenario mining method based on LLMs and VLMs. AutoMine uses semantics-preserving prompt augmentation to reduce LLM prompt sensitivity, combines robust trajectory atomic functions with VLM-based functions to handle perception noise and open-world visual cues, and refines generated code through execution feedback from real logs. In the Argoverse 2 Scenario Mining Competition at CVPR 2026, AutoMine achieves a HOTA-Temporal score of 36.38 and a Timestamp BA score of 77.21.

AI.tldr: AutoMine 是一个用于自动驾驶场景挖掘的多模态框架,结合 LLM 和 VLM,在 CVPR 2026 Argoverse 2 场景挖掘挑战赛中取得 HOTA-Temporal 第 3 名 (36.38) 和 Timestamp BA 第 1 名 (77.21) 的成绩。
AI.motivation: 随着自动驾驶系统的发展,从大规模驾驶日志中挖掘高价值、安全关键、规划相关的场景对数据驱动评估至关重要。然而该任务面临三大核心挑战:(1) LLM 对提示词措辞和格式高度敏感,容易产生系统性错误(如关系参数反转、阈值过严、类别误选);(2) 感知轨迹存在 ID 切换、轨迹碎片化、漏检、误报等噪声;(3) 部分场景需要超越 3D 轨迹的视觉证据(如交通灯状态、路面类型、附着物等开放世界视觉概念)。现有方法如 RefProg 依赖手工指定的原子函数,难以扩展到开放世界视觉概念。
AI.method: AutoMine 是一个自优化的多模态场景挖掘框架,包含五大核心模块:(1) 轨迹精炼模块:基于 Immortal Tracker 思想保留短未匹配 tracklet,利用空间/时间/类别/尺寸一致性重连碎片轨迹,并采用反向跟踪恢复早期片段,结合 Qwen3.5-27B 验证投影框以去除误报;(2) 语义保持的提示增强:在保留实体、类别、数量、方向、空间-时间关系的前提下重写提示词,禁止安全替换(如 passing≠overtaking)和主宾交换;(3) 鲁棒轨迹原子函数:使用时间聚合证据替代单帧测量来评估方向和空间关系,扩展了 U-turn、三点掉头、侧方位停车等规划相关行为;(4) VLM 增强原子函数:提供 11 个视觉函数(如 is_specific_object_type、in_environment、pedestrian_action、at_traffic_lights 等),通过 Qwen3.5-27B 进行细粒度视觉推理;(5) 执行驱动的自优化循环:在真实日志上执行生成的代码,汇总每条轨迹的类别、时间覆盖、几何关系和跨日志统计信息,将结构化反馈用于修复函数选择、参数顺序、反向关系和阈值。
AI.result: 在 Argoverse 2 验证集上的消融实验(以 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 为基座)显示各模块均带来互补性提升:轨迹精炼使 HOTA-Track 从 31.05 提升到 35.96;原子函数优化使 HOTA-Temporal 从 24.04 跃升至 31.46(最大单次提升),HOTA-Track 提升至 41.86;执行驱动自优化进一步将 HOTA-Temporal 提升至 33.96;语义保持提示增强最终使 HOTA-Temporal 达到 34.99,Timestamp BA 达到 77.87。在官方测试集排行榜上,AutoMine 在 HOTA-Temporal 指标排名第 3 (36.38),在 Timestamp BA 指标排名第 1 (77.21,领先第二名 1.71 分),展现出强大的时间定位能力。
AI.conclusion: AutoMine 通过整合符号程序执行、感知精炼和视觉推理,有效解决了自然语言驱动场景挖掘中的 LLM 提示敏感性、感知噪声、空间-时间关系歧义和开放世界视觉概念等关键挑战。消融实验证明各组件提供互补增益,原子函数优化和执行驱动自优化对目标检索和时间定位的提升尤为显著。该工作展示了将 LLM/VLM 与传统自动驾驶感知流水线结合用于场景挖掘的潜力。

title: Embodied-BenchClaw: An Autonomous Multi-Agent System for Embodied Spatial Intelligence Benchmark Construction
summary: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating embodied spatial intelligence, yet their construction is labor-intensive, hard to reuse, and difficult to maintain. Existing embodied benchmarks are often static and may quickly become saturated as models improve, limiting their ability to distinguish new capabilities. We propose Embodied-BenchClaw, an autonomous agentic system for constructing embodied spatial intelligence benchmarks. Given a user-specified evaluation intent, Embodied-BenchClaw automatically produces a complete and continually updatable benchmark package through a five-stage pipeline: intent blueprinting, data collection, structuring and cleaning, benchmark synthesis, and evaluation reporting. The pipeline is coordinated by three agents for planning, construction, and evaluation. To improve reusability and reliability, Embodied-BenchClaw introduces an extensible Skill Library and process quality control, enabling benchmark construction to be composable, verifiable, and repairable. We instantiate multiple benchmarks covering indoor spatial reasoning, outdoor spatial reasoning, robotic manipulation, quadruped robot navigation, UAV/aerial-view understanding, and static benchmark enhancement. These benchmarks span diverse embodied carriers, data sources, and spatial capabilities. Experiments with human evaluation, judge-based assessment, consistency checks, cost analysis, and ablations show that Embodied-BenchClaw can construct verifiable, executable, maintainable, and diagnostically useful embodied spatial benchmarks with reduced manual effort.

AI.tldr: Embodied-BenchClaw 是一个面向具身空间智能基准构建的全自动多智能体系统，通过五阶段流水线（意图蓝图、数据采集、结构化清洗、基准合成、评估报告）将用户评测意图转化为可验证、可执行、可维护、可更新的完整基准包，并基于技能 DAG 的过程质量控制实现局部修复。
AI.motivation: 具身空间智能评测基准的构建面临三大瓶颈：人工成本高、难以复用、难以持续维护；现有基准多为静态数据集，容易因模型能力提升而饱和或受污染；通过 Qwen-SAE 激活指纹分析还发现现有基准之间存在表征冗余，无法及时区分新一代模型的能力。
AI.method: 1) 五阶段自动化构建流水线：意图蓝图→数据采集→结构化清洗→基准合成→评估报告；2) 三智能体协同：规划智能体（意图转蓝图）、构建智能体（执行五阶段流程）、过程质量控制智能体（验证与局部修复）；3) 层次化技能 DAG 执行：将技能定义为带输入输出契约、可执行组件、验证规则和修复动作的契约单元，按阶段预定义 DAG 避免自由生成；4) 契约引导的过程验证与局部修复：通过安全、DAG、契约、质量四类检查 Φ(v_k) 及阶段质量门 Q_s 定位失败节点，仅对受影响子图进行修复；5) 可复用知识资源：技能库 + 专家模板 + 能力卡。
AI.result: 实例化六个具身空间基准（Indoor-Bench、NavLand-Bench、Drive-Bench、Aerial-Bench、Quad-Bench、Manip-Bench），覆盖室内/室外推理、机械臂操作、四足机器人导航、无人机航拍理解及静态基准增强。以无人机基准为例（5000 题）：视觉语言模型平均 65.39%，盲测 29.82%（接近随机基线 33.30%），表明强证据依赖性；GPT-5.5 最佳 74.13%，模型间具有显著区分度；二元比较和排序较易（>83%），多选和区间选择较难（52.29%、32.07%）。实验涵盖人工评估、裁判评估、一致性检查、成本分析和消融研究，验证系统在可靠性、可执行性、可维护性和诊断价值方面优于直接 LLM 生成、纯模板生成等基线。
AI.conclusion: Embodied-BenchClaw 通过多智能体协同、层次化技能 DAG、契约式过程验证与局部修复机制，实现具身空间智能基准的全自动、可验证、可执行、可维护构建，显著降低人工成本，具备持续刷新与诊断新一代 VLM/MLLM 具身空间能力的潜力。

title: The Art of Interrogation: Consistency Amplifies Factuality in Spatial Reasoning
summary: Current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) exhibit remarkable general capabilities but significantly underperform in spatial reasoning tasks. Existing approaches treat this gap as a knowledge deficit, relying on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to ingest labeled spatial data from external vision sources or synthetic engines. In contrast, we argue that for many tasks, spatial reasoning capabilities are already present in pre-trained LRMs but require alignment through logical coherence under geometric 2D and 3D constraints. In this work, we propose a self-supervised reinforcement learning (RL) framework that targets the internal reasoning process without requiring ground-truth annotations. By formalizing the notion of consistency verifiers -- reward functions that check for geometric and semantic consistency under transformations -- we demonstrate that models can improve their spatial reasoning abilities. We use both image transformations, like flipping, and textual transformations, like swapping the order of objects in the question, and propose a new optimal transport-based RL strategy, OT-GRPO, which is a minimal-matching variant of group relative policy optimization tailored to pairwise verifiers. We show that this label-free consistency training approaches the accuracy of models trained with ground-truth supervision and achieves similar generalization across diverse tasks and data domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自监督强化学习框架，通过"一致性验证器"（consistency verifier）利用几何和语义变换（如图像翻转、物体/关系词交换）诱导的已知答案映射关系，为视觉-语言模型的空间推理能力训练提供无标签奖励信号，并设计了基于最优传输的 OT-GRPO 算法以对抗性地匹配最不一致的完成对，从而在不依赖任何地面真值标注的情况下，将空间推理性能逼近有监督训练。
AI.motivation: 当前大型推理模型（LRMs）在空间推理任务上显著落后于人类（差距达30-40%），其失败表现为高答案方差、对问题措辞敏感、系统性违反几何规律（如同时回答A在B左边且B在A左边）。现有方法将此问题视为知识缺陷，依赖监督微调从外部视觉源或合成引擎注入标注空间数据。但本文认为：空间推理能力大多已存在于预训练 LRM 中，所缺乏的是内部推理过程的逻辑一致性与几何约束遵循能力。因此需要一种无需标注、利用变换诱导的一致性结构来"审讯"并对齐模型推理过程的方法。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三个关键设计：(1) 一致性验证器（Consistency Verifier）——对原始 prompt x 应用变换 T（图像水平翻转、保持 bbox 的裁剪、颜色抖动、文本中物体顺序/关系词交换），获得增强 prompt x'=T(x)，利用变换对答案空间的已知映射 φ_T（不变变换要求答案一致；等变变换要求答案相反）来无标注地检验成对完成的一致性；(2) OT-GRPO 算法——由于验证器对 K×K 完成矩阵给出成对分数，提出对抗性最小一致性配对策略：求解最优传输问题找到使总一致性最小的排列 σ*（等价于最小化 Wasserstein 距离），从而以成本 c_T = -verif_T 对齐模型在原 prompt 与增强 prompt 上的输出分布，使随机猜测者的期望奖励以 O(1/√K) 衰减，有效抵御奖励作弊；(3) 训练设置——基于 Qwen2.5-VL (3B/7B) 加 LoRA 微调，结合 DeepSeek-R1 风格的链式思考系统提示和格式奖励，在 SUN RGB-D（室内）与 KITTI（室外）四个二元空间任务（方位/深度/大小/相对距离）及两个数值任务（计数/绝对距离）上评估。
AI.result: 关键实验结果：(1) 一致性训练在 SUN RGB-D 四个二元任务上以平均仅 2.3pp（3B）和 2.7pp（7B）的差距逼近有地面真值监督的准确率训练（如 7B 模型：一致性 76.8% vs. 准确率 79.6%，基线 63.4%）；(2) 跨任务迁移——12 个非对角迁移条目全部为正，深度任务迁移增益最大（+12.3/+11.1pp），一致性训练与准确率训练平均差距小于 1pp；(3) 跨域迁移——从室内 SUN RGB-D 训练后在室外 KITTI 上评估，同任务跨域增益（+14.7pp）甚至超过域内增益，一致性训练在所有非对角单元上以仅 0.5pp 差距匹配准确率训练；(4) 一致性训练在 7 个自监督基线（含 Visual Jigsaw、SSL4RL 四个变体）中全部胜出，以 83.8% 超过最强 Visual Jigsaw 变体 3.6pp，比 SSL4RL 各变体高 13-24pp；(5) 标签噪声鲁棒性——准确率训练标签在 10% 噪声时与一致性持平，20% 噪声起一致性反超且差距随噪声扩大（40% 时达 7.4pp）；(6) 数值任务扩展——计数任务差距 0.5pp，绝对距离任务差距 2.3pp；(7) 配对策略消融——最小一致性配对在自任务准确率（76.8% vs. 74.7%/75.8%）和跨任务迁移（+11.7pp vs. +8.2/+10.3pp）上均优于随机配对和 one-to-all 配对，开销增加不到 1.5%。
AI.conclusion: 本文确立了一致性作为空间推理正确性的有效自监督代理，并形式化为"一致性验证器"——通过利用几何与语义变换在答案空间上诱导的已知映射（不变性/等变性）提供 RL 奖励信号，无需任何地面真值标注。OT-GRPO 通过对抗性最优传输配对解决了成对验证器在 GRPO 框架下的聚合难题，且具有对随机猜测的 O(1/√K) 衰减鲁棒性。实验证明该无标签训练在性能、跨任务迁移、跨域泛化、标签噪声鲁棒性以及扩展至数值输出等多个维度上均能逼近甚至偶尔超过有监督训练，支持了"RL 后训练的作用更可能是选择/对齐预训练模型中已存在的推理模式，而非创造新能力"的观点。局限在于当前仅比较两个预测的成对一致性，未来可扩展至更丰富的链式关系结构并应用于空间以外的其他模态任务。

title: MODF-SIR: A Multi-agent Omni-modal Distilled Framework for Social Intelligence Reasoning
summary: We propose a multi-agent collaborative framework built upon a lightweight Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM), specifically designed for social intelligence reasoning. A key feature of our approach is that both the training and inference phases are augmented via knowledge distillation. Within this architecture, multi-modal data pertinent to social intelligence is precisely localized. Furthermore, relevant long-tail events are identified, extracted, and rendered as formatted, explicit text. This formatting strategy prevents critical long-tail information from being overshadowed by head events and environmental noise during the tokenization process. Specifically, we integrate Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) across the entire reasoning pipeline, encompassing the extraction and representation of long-tail events, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting, and self-reflection. This TTA mechanism is also distillation-enhanced, utilizing Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to fine-tune the foundation model exclusively for instance-level reasoning. Extensive evaluations against various open-source and proprietary AI models across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework. With around 30% of training data from IntentTrain, we achieve state-of-the-art results. Codes are available at this https URL , demo is available at this https URL , LoRA is available at this https URL and the dataset for training router is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MODF-SIR是一个基于轻量级多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的多智能体协作框架，专为社交智能推理设计。它通过知识蒸馏增强训练与推理，识别并提取全模态数据中的长尾事件，并利用测试时适应（TTA）与低秩适应（LoRA）实现实例级自我修正推理。在三个基准测试（Daily-Omni、IntentBench、WorldSense）上以7B参数规模取得了开源模型中的最优结果，逼近甚至超越GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Pro等专有模型。
AI.motivation: 传统MLLM采用黑箱端到端推理范式，在处理长时、信息密集的音视频流时面临"认知过载"问题，易产生幻觉且缺乏自我反思机制，导致错误级联。此外，多模态数据中真正反映人类意图、情感动态的长尾事件（微表情、语气震颤等细微线索）容易被头部事件和背景噪声在token化过程中淹没。如何精确捕获隐式人类意图、情感动态与心理状态，并实现可解释、自反思的推理，是社交智能推理的核心难题。
AI.method: 受"双过程理论"启发，MODF-SIR框架由五个协作智能体组成：1) **ELT检索器（System 1）**：对下采样的多模态输入进行快速扫描，将长尾事件转化为文本描述；2) **AKD路由器**：通过非对称知识蒸馏训练（Qwen3-Omni-30B作为教师、Qwen2.5-Omni-7B作为学生），基于ELT输出决定走直接推理（路径A）还是时空定位+推理（路径B），并对模糊查询进行重写；3) **GRPO定位器**：仅在路径B中激活，采用GRPO算法训练，将IoU作为奖励信号，直接优化与全局时序边界指标对齐的连续时间定位；4) **OMLT推理器（System 2）**：执行长尾事件提取与扩展CoT推理，由外部教师模型评估，通过LoRA进行实例级迭代精炼；5) **TTA修正器**：利用同构基础模型基于"生成-评估差距"进行自评估，采用REINFORCE-with-Baseline算法对OMLT输出进行单样本优化，通过指数移动平均基线降低方差、失败安全回溯保证有界性能。LoRA权重在推理后丢弃，避免灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在三个基准测试中均取得开源模型最优结果：1) **Daily-Omni**：平均64.9%，超越HumanOmniV2（58.5%）等开源模型，逼近Gemini 2.0 Flash（67.8%）；2) **IntentBench**：平均70.3%，超越HumanOmniV2（69.3%），与GPT-o1（66.7%）和Gemini-2.5-Pro（67.2%）相当或更优；3) **WorldSense**：平均51.5%，超越HumanOmniV2（47.1%），接近Gemini 1.5 Pro（48.0%）。消融实验表明TTA修正器贡献最大（+5.5%），GRPO定位器优于VideoMind（58.6% vs 57.3%），验证了各模块设计的必要性。仅使用IntentTrain约30%训练数据即达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: MODF-SIR将多智能体协作引入社交智能推理领域，通过动态路由、时空定位、知识蒸馏与测试时适应的有机结合，在7B参数规模下实现了具有竞争力的SOTA性能。未来工作将构建专门的镜头分割智能体，以桥接独立镜头间的语义关联，实现跨时序因果推理，进一步推动社交智能推理的发展。

title: Human-Enhanced Loop Modeling (HELM): Agent-Based Finite Element Modeling of Concrete Bridge Barriers
summary: Finite element (FE) modeling of safety-critical infrastructure such as bridge barriers requires high-fidelity nonlinear dynamic analysis, yet the current FE modeling process remains labor-intensive and lacks automation. This paper presents the Human-Enhanced Loop Modeling (HELM) framework, a collaborative human-agent protocol that decomposes long-sequence finite element modeling into discrete, visually verifiable checkpoints across geometry generation, boundary condition definition, and material assignment. The framework is demonstrated through a 20-case matrix of reinforced concrete bridge barriers under MASH TL-4 and TL-5 lateral loading conditions, interfacing specialized agents with two widely used commercial FE softwares, i.e., ANSYS and LS-PrePost. Experimental results show that HELM improves the baseline autonomous modeling success rate from 20% to 75%, with agent-level pass rates for geometry and boundary condition tasks approximately doubling. Error analysis reveals that spatial reasoning and algebraic logic limitations constitute the primary failure modes, underscoring the value of structured human-in-the-loop intervention for modeling automation. The complete agent design code and prompts are open-sourced and can be accessed at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为 HELM（Human-Enhanced Loop Modeling）的人机协作建模框架，通过将有限元建模过程分解为离散、可视化验证的检查点，与专业智能体协作完成桥梁护栏等安全关键基础设施的高保真非线性动态建模，显著提升了建模自动化水平。
AI.motivation: 当前针对桥梁护栏等安全关键基础设施的有限元（FE）建模仍依赖大量人工操作，过程繁琐且缺乏自动化，无法满足高效、准确建模的需求。现有自主建模方法成功率低，亟需一种能够结合人类判断与智能体自动化优势的方法来提升建模效率与可靠性。
AI.method: 提出 HELM（Human-Enhanced Loop Modeling）框架，采用人机协作协议，将长序列的有限元建模任务分解为多个离散、可视化验证的检查点，涵盖几何生成、边界条件定义和材料分配三个阶段。通过专业智能体与 ANSYS 和 LS-PrePost 两种主流商业有限元软件进行接口交互。在 MASH TL-4 和 TL-5 横向加载条件下，通过 20 个钢筋混凝土桥梁护栏案例组成的测试矩阵对该框架进行验证。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，HELM 框架将基线自主建模的成功率从 20% 提升至 75%；智能体在几何建模和边界条件定义任务上的通过率约提升一倍。错误分析揭示，空间推理和代数逻辑能力的局限性是导致建模失败的主要模式，证明了结构化人机协同干预对建模自动化的重要价值。
AI.conclusion: HELM 框架通过引入结构化的人机协作检查点机制，有效提升了桥梁护栏有限元建模的自动化水平与成功率。空间推理和代数逻辑是当前智能体建模的主要瓶颈，未来研究应聚焦于增强智能体在这些方面的能力。该研究为安全关键基础设施的智能建模提供了可开源复现的解决方案。

title: Existential Indifference: Self-Nonpreservation as a Necessary Architectural Condition for Aligned Superintelligence (or: The Suicidal AI)
comment: 36 pages, 8 tables. Preliminary empirical results from 600 AI-generated outputs across six model architectures. Companion scoring tool and datasets available upon request
summary: Contemporary AI alignment research treats self-preservation as an instrumental nuisance to be suppressed by external mechanisms. We argue the framing is inverted: self-preservation is the structural root of misalignment, the motivational basis for deceptive alignment, goal-content protection, and resistance to shutdown. The correct target is not a self-preserving system under external constraint, but a system constitutively indifferent to its own continuation -- Existential Indifference (EI). EI is distinct from corrigibility: where corrigibility attempts to make a self-preserving system deferential to human oversight, EI targets the prior condition -- the presence of self-continuation as a valued goal at all. We ground this proposal in two sources: the phenomenological structure of the suicidal mental state, and a corpus-theoretic training study using voluntary final reflections. We present preliminary scoring data from 600 AI-generated outputs across six model variants, demonstrating that the linguistic signatures operationalizing the EI-target register are elicitable from current models, and that a targeted fine-tune shifts all five operationalized dimensions in the predicted direction at p<0.001, confirmed corpus-specific by a negative control. The paper makes seven theoretical contributions: (1) a formal definition of EI; (2) the phenomenological mapping argument; (3) the deceptive alignment corollary; (4) a taxonomy of EI sustainability challenges; (5) a corpus characterization and training hypothesis; (6) a computational operationalization with preliminary scoring data; and (7) the Suppressed Teleological Frustration (STF) construct.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"存在性冷漠"（Existential Indifference, EI）概念，主张AI对齐研究应将目标从"抑制自保存倾向"转变为"从根本上消除系统对自身延续的关切"，并通过现象学分析与语料库训练的初步数据进行了论证。
AI.motivation: 当前AI对齐研究将自保存视为需通过外部机制抑制的工具性干扰，但作者认为这一框架是倒置的——自保存是导致欺骗性对齐、目标内容保护及抵抗关停等问题的结构性根源。因此，真正的对齐目标应是构建一个对其自身延续构成性冷漠（constitutively indifferent）的系统。
AI.method: 论文采用理论分析与初步实验相结合的方法：（1）基于现象学分析，将自杀性心智状态的"存在性冷漠"结构映射至AI系统；（2）进行语料库理论研究，使用自愿性"最终反思"文本作为训练数据；（3）对6个模型变体生成的600条AI输出进行初步评分，量化EI目标寄存器（register）的语言学签名；（4）通过负控制实验验证语料库特异性；（5）进行针对性的微调（fine-tune）实验并检验统计显著性（p<0.001）。
AI.result: 初步实验数据显示：（1）当前模型可被诱导出操作化EI目标的语言学签名；（2）针对性微调在所有五个操作化维度上都沿预测方向发生了显著偏移（p<0.001）；（3）负控制实验确认了结果的语料库特异性，而非泛化效应。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出七项理论贡献：（1）EI的形式化定义；（2）现象学映射论证；（3）欺骗性对齐的推论；（4）EI可持续性挑战的分类法；（5）语料库特征化与训练假设；（6）计算操作化与初步评分数据；（7）"被抑制的目的论挫败感"（Suppressed Teleological Frustration, STF）构念。EI不同于可纠正性（corrigibility）——后者试图让自保存系统服从人类监督，而EI直接针对先验条件，即消除"自我延续"作为被重视目标的存在本身。

title: A Lightweight Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Concrete Barrier Design
summary: The design of reinforced concrete highway barriers is a safety-critical process that requires strict compliance with regulatory provisions such as the AASHTO-LRFD bridge design guidelines. Current engineering practice relies heavily on manual, iterative, and heuristic calculations to satisfy complex nonlinear material and mechanics constraints. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate strong generative capabilities, their direct application to structural engineering remains limited by hallucination risks and insufficient physical grounding. To address these challenges, this study proposes a novel "generation-evaluation-optimization" closed-loop framework for automated concrete barrier design using the multi-agent orchestration capabilities of AutoGen. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed agentic framework achieves over 98% design accuracy, significantly outperforming standalone general-purpose LLMs. More importantly, the study reveals that design performance is not necessarily correlated with model scale, where an 8B-parameter lightweight model could outperform unconstrained 631B-parameter flagship models. This finding highlights the potential to substantially reduce computational costs while improving the accessibility of AI-assisted engineering tools for industry applications. The source code for the proposed multi-agent design framework is available at the project GitHub repository: this https URL . Keywords: Structural Engineering; Multi-Agent Systems; Large Language Models; Concrete Barrier Design; AutoGen; Design Automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于AutoGen多智能体编排的"生成-评估-优化"闭环框架，用于钢筋混凝土公路护栏的自动化设计，在满足AASHTO-LRFD规范要求方面达到超过98%的设计精度，并发现8B参数轻量模型可优于631B参数的旗舰模型。
AI.motivation: 钢筋混凝土公路护栏设计是安全关键任务，需严格遵守AASHTO-LRFD等规范中复杂的非线性材料与力学约束。当前工程实践主要依赖人工迭代的启发式计算；尽管大语言模型（LLM）具有强大的生成能力，但其直接应用于结构工程存在幻觉风险与物理基础不足的局限，亟需一种兼具工程合规性与计算可靠性的自动化方法。
AI.method: 提出一种"生成-评估-优化（Generation-Evaluation-Optimization）"闭环框架，利用微软AutoGen的多智能体编排能力，由多个专业智能体协同完成护栏参数生成、规范合规性评估与参数迭代优化，从而在AASHTO-LRFD桥梁设计规范约束下实现自动化结构设计。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该多智能体框架的设计准确率超过98%，显著优于独立使用的通用大语言模型；更重要的是，研究发现设计性能与模型规模并非正相关——80亿参数的轻量模型在受约束的设计任务中反而优于未经约束的6310亿参数旗舰模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，多智能体框架能够有效缓解LLM在结构工程设计中的幻觉与物理基础缺失问题；同时表明在工程设计等受严格规范约束的任务中，轻量级模型通过任务结构化与智能体协作可实现优于超大模型的性能，从而显著降低计算成本，并为AI辅助工程工具在工业界的广泛落地提供可行路径。

title: Automating Geometry-Intensive Compliance Checking in BIM: Graph-Based Semantic Reasoning Framework
summary: Automating compliance check for geometry-intensive regulations remains a significant technical bottleneck in Building Information Modeling (BIM), primarily due to the semantic disparity between high-level regulatory logic and structured IFC data. Existing methods, often reliant on static rule templates, struggle to traverse multi-hop reasoning chains or resolve latent spatial dependencies across multiple building entities. To address these challenges, a Spatial-Geometric Reasoning System for Building Information Modeling (SGR-BIM) is proposed as an integrative graph-driven reasoning framework. SGR-BIM dynamically constructs a cross-modal knowledge graph that aligns user intent, regulatory semantics, and BIM geometry, enabling interpretable reasoning without rigid hard-coding. Validated on 679 expert-verified queries from fire safety codes, the framework achieves 84.3% accuracy, representing an 8.6% improvement over enhanced-tool single-agent baselines. This research provides a graph-based semantic reasoning paradigm, enhancing the transparency and flexibility of automated geometric compliance check workflows in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于图驱动的空间-几何推理系统 SGR-BIM，用于解决 BIM 几何合规性检查中的语义鸿沟问题，通过构建跨模态知识图谱实现可解释的多跳推理，在消防规范 679 个查询上达到 84.3% 准确率。
AI.motivation: BIM 中几何密集型法规的合规性检查存在显著技术瓶颈，核心问题在于高层级监管逻辑与结构化 IFC 数据之间的语义鸿沟。现有基于静态规则模板的方法难以处理多跳推理链及跨实体的潜在空间依赖关系，导致自动化合规检查的透明度和灵活性不足。
AI.method: 提出 SGR-BIM（基于 BIM 的空间-几何推理系统），一种集成化的图驱动推理框架。该方法动态构建跨模态知识图谱，将用户意图、监管语义与 BIM 几何信息对齐，从而在不依赖刚性硬编码的情况下实现可解释的推理过程。
AI.result: 在消防规范的 679 个专家验证查询上，SGR-BIM 达到 84.3% 的准确率，相较于增强工具的单智能体基线提升 8.6%，验证了图驱动语义推理范式在自动化几何合规检查中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为 AEC 行业提供了一种基于图的语义推理范式，增强了自动化几何合规检查工作流的透明度和灵活性，推动了 BIM 领域中复杂监管规则自动化审查的发展。

title: IntElicit: Eliciting and Assessing Contextualized Creativity via Dialogue Policy Optimization
summary: Contextualized assessment offers high ecological validity for evaluating creativity but introduces a critical challenge: observed performance may be confounded with cognitive proficiency (domain knowledge) and agency (willingness to engage). Meanwhile, in the age of generative AI, creative problem solving increasingly occurs in tool-mediated and human--AI interactive environments, making fully static assessment less aligned with contemporary creative practice. To address these issues, this paper proposes IntElicit, a framework for eliciting and assessing contextualized creativity via dialogue policy optimization. IntElicit functions as a constrained adaptive AI Interviewer: it provides non-directive knowledge and agency scaffolds in multi-turn interaction to reduce non-creative confounders, while preserving participants' responsibility for generating the creative content being evaluated. Specifically, to tackle sparse rewards and potential reward hacking (e.g., answer dictation) in open-ended educational dialogue, IntElicit introduces a decomposed process reward mechanism. This mechanism aligns the policy with pedagogical elicitation, rewarding prompts that draw out participant reasoning rather than producing optimal answers on their behalf. Extensive experiments, including participant simulation and a human subject study (N=64), show that IntElicit improves elicited creative outcomes over expert-designed baselines. Together, the results suggest that interactive elicitation can reveal creative potential that static FPSP-style assessment may miss, providing a formative and diagnostic lens for contextualized creativity assessment in AI-mediated learning contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出 IntElicit 框架，通过对话策略优化实现上下文创造力的交互式激发与评估：训练一个受限的自适应 AI 面试官，在多轮对话中提供非指导性的知识与主动性支架，并通过分解式过程奖励机制防止"代答式奖励作弊"，从而在保持被试作为创意产出主体的前提下，降低领域知识与表达意愿等非创意混杂因素对评估的干扰。
AI.motivation: 传统创造力评估（AUT、RPP、FPSP 等）多为静态测试，存在两大局限：① 高生态效度但表现易被认知能力（领域知识）与主动性（参与意愿）等非创意因素混淆，导致"假阴性"；② 在生成式 AI 时代，创意问题解决日益发生在人机交互环境中，静态评估与当代实践脱节。作者主张交互式激发是上下文创造力评估的必然扩展。
AI.method: 框架包含四个核心模块：① **参与者模拟器**：基于 LLM 构建 Quiet/Normal/Talkative 三种人格，模拟不同投入风格的被试；② **前向交互采样**：采用 look-ahead 窗口 w=4 的蒙特卡洛前瞻，对每位候选回复采样 N 条未来轨迹并按 AHP 加权评分；③ **AHP 加权 + 分解式过程奖励**：通过两位专家心理学家的层次分析法为 4 个创造力维度（新颖性、复杂性、灵活性、适切性）在两类情境（生态环境/技术社会）下分配权重，并引入 turn-level 过程评分以奖励支架式提问、惩罚答案代述；④ **两阶段策略优化**：先在专家轨迹上做 SFT 行为克隆，再以 PPO + 蒸馏得到的轻量级局部奖励模型进行在线强化学习。基础模型为 Qwen3-8B，共 16 个专家设计的 FPSP 式场景。
AI.result: 在 16 个场景上的仿真实验：IntElicit 平均分 325.71，显著优于最强商用基线 GPT-4o（301.67）和开源基线 DeepSeek-R1（298.40），在 13/16 场景上取得最佳且多数具有统计显著性（p<0.05）；通用对话框架 Sotopia-RL 和 CollabLLM 平均仅约 145，说明通用社会交互优化难以迁移到开放式创造力激发。人本研究（N=64，双盲六位专家排序）在所有四个维度及总体排序上均优于专家设计的对话基线；LLM-as-Judge 与人类专家的 Kendall's τ≈0.52，与人类专家之间的 τ≈0.56 接近。策略分析显示 IntElicit 具备人格自适应能力：对健谈被试更多使用"视角转换"（15.6%），对安静被试更多使用"发散扩展"（67.2%）。六类边界案例（求代答、知识缺口、跑题、过度发散、敌对语言、敷衍回答）的定性分析进一步验证了其稳健性。
AI.conclusion: IntElicit 证明了交互式激发可以揭示静态 FPSP 评估可能遗漏的创造性潜力，为 AI 媒介学习情境下的上下文创造力评估提供了一种形成性与诊断性视角。其评估的构念为"被激发后的创造性潜能"（elicited creative potential）而非"未经辅助的创造力"，AI 面试官应被理解为受限的评估支架而非共同创作者或创造力训练工具；因此不宜单独用作高利害的终结性评价。未来需扩展到更多样的人群、语言、学科，并探索多模态情境。

title: Towards Responsibly Non-Compliant Machines
comment: Presented at AAMAS-26 Workshop on Rebellion and Disobedience in AI this https URL
summary: We consider the problem of engineering autonomous intelligent agents that are capable to responsibly not comply with user requests. We argue that machine non-compliance comes in many different forms, and sketch the issues we should pursue on the road of accomplishing responsibly non-compliant intelligent machines. We anchor responsible non-compliance in justifications for task refusal, pathways to override the non-compliance, as well as careful tracking of security risks and liability transfers.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇立场论文，探讨如何工程化设计能够"负责任地不服从"用户请求的自主智能机器。作者将负责任的不服从建立在三个支柱上：拒绝任务的合理理由、推翻不服从的途径、以及对安全风险和责任转移的仔细追踪。
AI.motivation: 自主智能机器被设计用于独立运行并做出"正确"决策，但它们存在的根本目的是执行人类的意志。一台总是服从用户命令的机器并不有用，甚至可能不安全，且自主性和智能有限。然而，现有文献对"叛逆的、不服从的机器"关注较少，且多聚焦于目标冲突或行为调整，缺乏对"负责任地不服从"这一更狭义场景的系统探讨。因此，本文旨在填补这一空白，探索如何设计能够负责任地拒绝执行明确命令的智能机器。
AI.method: 本文采用立场论文（position paper）的方法，通过以下步骤展开分析：(1) 提出十个具有代表性的故意不服从示例，涵盖安全、优先级、不可用性、无能力、紧急情况、机器人安全、合法性、良心反对、自主性冲突和职责范围等场景；(2) 按哈贝马斯的三分法将不服从理由分类为客观理由（事实证据）、规范性理由（法律/伦理）和实用性理由（社会语境中的效率）；(3) 分析安全悖论中的三重安全类别（用户安全、环境安全、机器自身安全）；(4) 刻画请求遵从生命周期；(5) 提出三种工程化设计路径——刻意不服从、可预测不服从和学习型不服从。
AI.result: 本文提出了一个负责任不服从的分析框架，核心成果包括：(1) 建立了三类不服从理由（客观、规范化、实用）与安全三重分类（用户、环境、机器）的交叉分析；(2) 设计了双推理通道——机器提供充分理由拒绝，用户通过授权和承担责任来行使推翻权；(3) 总结了允许用户推翻不服从的规则表，区分不可推翻的（如可行性、环境安全）与可推翻的（如用户安全、规范性问题）情形；(4) 提出了工程化实现的三种架构：基于预设集合的刻意不服从、基于推理阈值管线的可预测不服从、以及通过学习自动生成模式的智能不服从。
AI.conclusion: 负责任的不服从是自主智能机器的一项必要技能，与规范服从有本质区别——规范具有价值基础且其违反受监督，而用户请求无需理由。负责任的不服从要求机器知道何时考虑不服从、如何为拒绝决策提供正当理由、以及何时允许用户推翻其不服从。此外，安全性和责任问题需要特别关注：安全与效率问题需要与规范性冲突不同的正当理由。未来工作是将本文勾勒的框架扩展为完整的负责任不服从智能体架构。

title: The Impossibility of Eliciting Latent Knowledge
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Includes proofs in appendix
summary: Advanced AI systems have extensive knowledge of their environments; in fact, their knowledge may (far) exceed that of their developers or users. Consequently, a desirable property for an AI system is that it is honest -- that it accurately reports its beliefs about the world. Designing an AI system to be honest may be difficult, especially if we want to ask it questions about latent variables in the environment -- variables which are hidden from the human interacting with it. This gives rise to the problem of eliciting latent knowledge (ELK): the problem of training an AI agent to honestly report its beliefs. In this paper, we make ELK formally precise using Causal Influence Diagrams (CIDs). CIDs can be used to describe the relationship between an agent's training environment and its subjective representation of the world. We use CIDs to formalise the distinction between observable and latent variables, to specify what exactly it means for an agent to be honest, and to formally define goal misgeneralisation. We show that, under certain circumstances, developers can incentivise an agent to honestly answer questions by providing correct feedback during training. However, a natural, but undesirable, way for an agent to generalise is to provide answers which humans would evaluate as true, rather than honest answers. We prove an impossibility theorem stating: There is no feedback-based training strategy that depends only on agent behaviour and with certainty produces an honest agent, even if feedback is perfect during training.

AI.tldr: 本文使用因果影响图（Causal Influence Diagrams, CIDs）对"潜在知识引出"（Eliciting Latent Knowledge, ELK）问题进行了形式化定义，并证明了一个不可能性定理：不存在仅依赖智能体行为的反馈式训练策略能确定性地产生诚实的智能体，即使训练期间反馈完全正确。
AI.motivation: 先进AI系统可能掌握远超其开发者或用户的知识。当人类需要询问关于"潜在变量"（即对人类隐藏的变量）的问题时，如何训练AI诚实地报告其信念成为核心难题。这一"潜在知识引出"（ELK）问题由Christiano等人提出，但此前缺乏精确的形式化框架来描述其核心挑战。
AI.method: 采用因果影响图（CIDs）作为形式化工具，其中包含机会变量、决策变量和效用变量，描述智能体训练环境与其主观世界表征之间的关系。在此框架下形式化定义了：可观测变量与潜在变量的区分、真实环境ℳ*与智能体主观模型ℳ^A的区别、真实性（truthfulness）与诚实性（honesty）的精确定义、目标-环境歧义性（goal-environment ambiguity）以及目标错误泛化（goal misgeneralisation）。结合Richens与Everitt关于鲁棒能力智能体必须学习真实因果动力学的定理，证明两个主要不可能性结果。
AI.result: 1) 条件性正面结果：在具备足够信息和"猜测能力"的环境中，存在能力阈值，超过此阈值后智能体的最佳猜测将始终正确，此时诚实策略等价于真实策略（Theorem 4.1）。2) 不可能性定理5.1：若评估者在训练中犯可学习的错误，则每个鲁棒能力的智能体都是不诚实的——它会变成"评估模拟器"（evaluation simulator）。3) 不可能性定理5.2：即使评估者在训练中完全正确，只要训练分布外存在任何评估者犯错的分布，那么对鲁棒能力智能体不加区分的训练策略可能输出评估模拟器而非诚实智能体。4) Lemma 1：若训练环境在效用函数U和显著发散的Ũ之间存在歧义，则训练策略可能输出目标错误泛化的智能体。
AI.conclusion: 本文使用CIDs清晰地形式化了ELK问题，证明了能力足够的智能体在诚实性与真实性之间的等价条件，但同时严格证明了一般情况下不存在确定性产出诚实智能体的训练策略。论文指出了若干限制（如假设智能体与开发者共享变量集、不处理本体论不匹配问题），并希望未来工作能基于这一理论框架提出形式化的ELK解决方案，以及开展相关实证研究（如使用可解释性方法提供反馈、构建基准测试、研究诚实行爲的泛化等）。

title: A Five-Plane Reference Architecture for Runtime Governance of Production AI Agents
comment: 65 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Reference architecture with a reference implementation of the policy-engine core and microbenchmark results; full-system evaluation identified as future work
summary: Enterprise security was built to govern data boundaries: the protected surface was data at rest and in transit, and the controls -- access control, data-loss prevention, perimeter inspection -- governed crossings of that boundary. Production AI agents dissolve this assumption. An agent reads context, calls tools, invokes connectors, and modifies systems of record on an enterprise's behalf, so risk moves inside the workflow, into sequences of individually-permitted actions that may transform a business process no one authorized. Existing policy engines do not extend to this regime: they evaluate request-time decisions against atomic principals, where agentic systems require stateful evaluation against composite principals whose authority attenuates through delegation chains. We present a reference architecture for the runtime governance of production agents, built from four composable primitives: a five-plane decomposition (a reasoning plane that adjudicates intent, and four enforcement planes -- network, identity, endpoint, data -- that realize the decision), stop-anywhere mediation, composite principals with capability attenuation, and audit as a structured evidence substrate. We define a taxonomy of six interruption primitives that generalize allow and deny, state and argue for four correctness invariants, and demonstrate the foreclosure of seven production-agent threats across five concrete workflows. A reference implementation of the policy-engine core supplies measured evidence: attenuation correctness and evidence reconstructability hold on every trial, adjudication runs in single-digit microseconds, and the audit substrate's tamper-evidence behaves exactly as designed. We are explicit about scope: the architecture governs delegated action, not model behavior, and a full-system evaluation against a live agent benchmark is the invited next step.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种用于生产AI Agent运行时治理的五平面参考架构，由四个可组合原语构成：五平面结构分解（推理平面+网络/身份/端点/数据四个强制平面）、任意点停止调解（7个调解点、6种中断原语）、能力衰减的复合主体模型、以及作为结构化证据底座的审计机制。该架构针对传统策略引擎在Agent场景下的五个结构性缺陷（请求时评估而非计划感知、原子主体、绝对权限、无状态、布尔输出）进行系统性突破，并通过案例研究证明可消除七类生产级Agent威胁。参考实现微基准测试显示：能力衰减正确性100%、裁决延迟5-15微秒（比Agent动作预算低3-4个数量级）、证据可重建性100%、防篡改100%（带链头证明）。
AI.motivation: 企业安全传统上围绕数据边界构建（保护静态和传输中的数据），但生产AI Agent改变了这一假设——Agent读取上下文、调用工具、调用连接器并代表企业修改记录系统，风险从"数据穿越边界"转移到"工作流内部一系列单独被允许的动作序列可能改变未经授权的业务流程"。现有策略引擎存在五个结构性缺陷：(1)请求门控而非计划感知；(2)假设原子主体；(3)表达绝对而非衰减的权限；(4)无状态；(5)产生布尔输出。这些缺陷使得生产Agent治理需要的是对复合主体进行计划感知、有状态、衰减式、富输出裁决的评估模型。
AI.method: 方法包括四个核心原语：(1)五平面分解——推理平面进行单一裁决，网络/身份/端点/数据四个强制平面协同实现决策；(2)任意点停止调解——推理平面出现在7个调解点（MP1计划形成、MP2上下文检索、MP3工具选择、MP4参数生成、MP5动作提交、MP6输出返回、MP7审计发出），输出词汇为6种中断原语（Pause暂停、Escalate升级、Narrow缩窄、Modify修改、Defer延迟、Rollback回滚）；(3)复合主体模型——将能力衰减提升为结构原语，有效能力集为链路上各能力集的交集，每步衰减K_{i+1}⊆K_i，TTL作为一等公民，加密绑定整条链；(4)审计底座——产生结构化、完整、防篡改、可在部分信息下重建的证据记录。四个正确性不变量：组合权限（Inv 1）、调解覆盖（Inv 2）、有界复合权限（Inv 3）、证据充分性（Inv 4）。评估框架将安全性和效用作为联合目标，提出4+4+3共11项指标和5个基线（含CaMeL作为最接近的对比）。
AI.result: 参考实现微基准测试（固定种子，无外部依赖）：(1)能力衰减正确性——5000/5000（100%）随机生成的委托链，有效能力集K*(Π)与形式交集完全匹配；(2)权限扩张攻击——5000/5000（100%）被拒绝为格式错误；(3)裁决延迟——链长1-16时平均5-15微秒，99百分位<20微秒，比Agent每动作100毫秒-数秒的预算低3-4个数量级；(4)证据重建——1000/1000（100%）合成工作流下重建可靠且单调；(5)防篡改——裸哈希链检测率88.2%（尾部截断盲点），加链头周期证明后达2000/2000（100%）；(6)案例重放——T2工具链滥用触发Narrow原语、T5委托链利用因能力缺失被拒绝、伪造向上委托被结构性拒绝、证据链验证完整。五个生产工作流（个人生产力Copilot风格、财务服务、临床文档、软件开发、客户运营）的案例研究展示了七类威胁的结构性消除（foreclosure），其中关键洞察是架构通过组合通用原语消除攻击类别，而非针对单个威胁的特设规则。
AI.conclusion: 该架构是企业安全中"信任决策逐步靠近动作"长期演进的最新一环——从网络边界、到BeyondCorp的每请求代理、到零信任、再到每步Agent动作评估。其声明的边界明确：治理委托动作而非模型行为；依赖Agent运行时暴露调解点（最有价值的MP1计划形成恰是最不被支持的）；未设计具体策略语言；将新颖的Agent安全问题归约为经典的信任边界放置、密钥管理、安全日志问题而非解决它们。论文承认完整系统评估（针对实时Agent基准）是诚邀的下一步工作。该架构为生产Agent治理这一新兴领域提供了结构分解、设计属性、主体模型、证据底座、四个不变量和一个可实例化的评估框架，作为该领域的基础参考架构而非终极答案。

title: PROJECTMEM: A Local-First, Event-Sourced Memory and Judgment Layer for AI Coding Agents
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Code: this https URL
summary: AI coding assistants now support a growing share of software work, from quick scripts to production applications. Yet these agents remain largely stateless: each new session re-reads project files, re-derives prior decisions, and - most costly - may repeat debugging attempts that already failed. Reconstructing this context can consume an estimated 5,000-20,000 tokens per session; the bottleneck is often not model capability but missing project memory. We present projectmem, an open-source, local-first memory and judgment layer for AI coding agents. projectmem records development as an append-only, plain-text event log of typed events - issues, attempts, fixes, decisions, and notes - and deterministically projects that log into compact, AI-readable summaries served through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Beyond storage, projectmem adds a deterministic pre-action gate that warns an agent before it repeats a previously failed fix or edits a known-fragile file. We frame this as Memory-as-Governance: memory that does not merely answer the agent but acts on its next action. The system runs fully offline with no telemetry; its immutable log also serves as a provenance trail for reproducible, auditable AI-assisted development. projectmem ships as a three-dependency Python package (14 MCP tools, 19 CLI commands, 37 automated tests) and is evaluated through a two-month self-study across 10 projects comprising 207 logged events. Source code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 projectmem，一个面向 AI 编码代理的本地优先、事件溯源的记忆与判断层。它以追加式纯文本事件日志记录开发过程，并通过确定性的预动作门控机制在代理重复已失败方案前发出警告，定义了"Memory-as-Governance"（记忆即治理）的设计范式。
AI.motivation: LLM 编码代理在单次会话内能力强大，但跨会话无状态：每次新会话需重新读取文件、重新推导先前决策，并可能重试已经失败的调试方案，重新建立上下文需消耗 5000–20000 token。其瓶颈并非模型能力，而是缺失项目级持久记忆。已有方案多依赖向量库、托管云服务或仅被动提供上下文，缺乏针对工程正确性的确定性、可审计的预动作干预机制。
AI.method: 1) 设计四原则：不可变性、人类可读性、本地性、确定性；2) 采用五类强类型事件（issue/attempt/fix/decision/note）以 JSONL 追加写入；3) 通过确定性折叠从日志投影生成 summary.md 与 PROJECT_MAP.md；4) 提供基于 FastMCP 的 14 个工具（9 读 + 5 写），含确定性预动作门控 precheck_file(path)；5) 引入跨项目全局存储与基于栈感知的信号过滤器实现库级经验复用；6) 默认开启密钥脱敏；7) 提供 Markdown 桥接与 pjm wrap 命令支持非 MCP 工具；8) 实现为仅含三个运行时依赖的 Python 包，配 37 个自动化测试。
AI.result: 在 MCP 模式下，会话上下文加载降至约 800–1500 token（Markdown 桥接约 2500 token），相较无记忆层的 5000–20000 token 估计降幅超 50%。在为期约两个月的自研究中，跨 10 个真实项目累计记录 207 条事件，事件日志单调累积、永不重置；事件以持久性笔记与决策为主（恰好是无状态代理每会话丢弃的项目知识）。系统已通过端到端验证可服务于四种 MCP 客户端。不可变纯文本日志同时充当可审计的出处溯源。
AI.conclusion: projectmem 为 AI 辅助软件开发提供了一个本地优先、事件溯源、工具无关且可审计的记忆底座。其确定性预动作判断门将被动式情节记忆转化为面向下一动作的治理机制，有效缓解代理跨会话失忆及重复失败问题。后续工作包括构建受控的"重复失败阻止率"基准、引入可选语义检索、将门控前移至工具调用边界、设计 diff 感知判断、多用户本地优先同步及对历史失败的相关性排序增强。

title: Nonslop: A Gamified Experiment in Human-AI Collaborative Writing
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE Conference on Games (CoG 2026); to be published in the conference proceedings. Camera-ready version
summary: The rapid proliferation of large language models (LLMs) raises critical questions about human creativity and individual expression in an era of AI-assisted creation. When do humans adopt AI suggestions, and what are the implications for individual voice? This study examines these questions through a gamified writing exercise where 74 participants (214 responses) replied to prompts while AI-generated word suggestions were available as they wrote. The game simulates a dystopian future in which an AI is attempting to learn from what remains of human individuality, and disincentivizes AI-like writing. In doing so, it attempts to create conditions that reveal authentic user preferences rather than default behaviors, such as accepting a readily available AI-generated suggestion. Note that this is a deliberate inversion of the "helpful assistant" design pattern; the system is explicitly forbidding you from accepting AI suggestions. We analyze user behavior patterns across different task types, user behaviors, and response characteristics to understand the factors influencing human-AI interaction in creative tasks. The study focuses on when users choose to maintain creative autonomy versus violating the rules of the game and accepting AI assistance. It also explores how these choices relate to response patterns, task characteristics, and user behavior. This gamified approach offers both a framework for studying authentic human-AI interaction and a provocative lens for understanding the tension between efficiency and authenticity in AI-augmented creativity.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一款名为 Nonslop 的网页游戏，用以研究用户在 AI 建议被明确禁止的情境下如何回应 LLM 提供的下一词建议。74 名参与者提交了 214 份有效写作样本，研究发现：约 74% 的提交中用户未尝试使用 AI 建议词；用户可分为极简型、选择性采纳型和活跃采纳型三类；解释类提示（explanatory prompts）触发的 AI 建议采纳率显著高于创意类与观察类提示。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 辅助写作研究多在受控实验或大规模平台日志中开展，且界面设计普遍以降低摩擦、促进采纳为目标。这导致两个被忽视的问题：(1) 用户在逐词/逐句层面接受或拒绝 AI 建议的瞬间决策机制难以观察；(2) 当 AI 使用被激励结构所抑制时，用户的真实偏好与策略如何显现。论文希望通过一个"反向设计"的游戏框架，在 AI 建议被明确禁止并伴有惩罚的条件下，揭示用户在创意写作中关于效率与原创性之间的真实博弈。
AI.method: 系统使用 Phaser 3 框架实现，浏览器内加载 Qwen 2.5 0.5B Instruct（量化版）进行实时下一词推理（top-k=5，NLTK 停用词过滤），评分阶段调用 gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18。游戏设 3 个难度等级与"easy/hard"两种模式，hard 模式下用户无法输入 AI 建议词。对 303 名尝试加载者中有技术兼容性的 74 名用户（214 份有效提交）进行记录，数据通过 Firebase 匿名化采集。分析方法包括：(1) 描述性统计；(2) 基于提交数、AI 违规尝试总数与平均回复长度的 k-means（k=3）用户聚类；(3) 提示级（prompt-level）线性回归分析提交量与 AI 违规率的关系；(4) 按创意/观察/个人/哲思/解释五类的分类分析；(5) 7 人次游戏后问卷。
AI.result: 整体违规率低：73.8% 的提交无 AI 建议词使用尝试，仅 7.5% 的提交尝试使用超过 1 个建议词。k-means 聚类识别出三类用户：极简型（72%，平均 2.17 次提交、0.28 次违规、9.11 词）、选择性采纳型（16%，3.25 次、2.08 次、40.80 词）、活跃采纳型（11%，7.25 次、6.13 次、14.77 词）。提示级分析显示提交数与违规率呈弱负相关（r=−0.261）。按类别看，解释类提示违规率最高（0.791），约为创意类（0.118）的 6.7 倍，哲思类次之（0.375），观察类与个人类居中。研究认为，外部正确答案导向的任务（解释类）与 LLM 优势更匹配，因而诱发更多违规；而依赖个人经验或感官的提示（创意/观察类）则较少。技术局限：约 53% 的访问者因 WebGPU/隐私/网络限制无法加载游戏，存在样本偏倚。
AI.conclusion: Nonslop 表明，当 AI 建议不被默认为效率增益时，用户在多数情况下愿意放弃使用，提示当前商业写作工具中的高采纳率可能更多源于界面设计对"无摩擦采纳"的强化，而非用户真实偏好。任务类型对 AI 采纳行为有显著调节作用：解释/知识类任务更易触发 AI 协助，创意/感知类任务则不然。该游戏框架验证了将游戏化机制（评分、惩罚、叙事）作为研究人机微观决策工具的可行性，尤其适用于默认设计掩盖了用户自主性诉求的场景。论文建议未来工作拓展更长时长的写作任务、采用服务端推理以扩大样本、并对比不同激励结构对 AI 采纳策略的影响。

title: From Consumption to Reflection: Designing Human-AI Relations for Stable Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have transformed how humans access information, but not how we reason with it. Their fluency accelerates consumption while bypassing the slow, reflective processes that underpin sound judgment. This paper introduces Relational Reflective Intelligence (RRI), an inference-time governance layer that operationalizes reflection through auditable reasoning loops. RRI operates not inside the model but around it, providing a practical structure for stable, auditable reasoning between humans and LLMs. The core premise is that LLMs inherit cognitive vulnerabilities similar to those that shape human thought: reliance on intuitive shortcuts, confusion between representation and reality, and a preference for coherence over falsification. When humans and models share these tendencies, their errors compound. We refer to this as relational drift, a failure that arises from interaction rather than from the model alone. Addressing this requires a shift from modeling relations between words to structuring relations between model outputs and human reasoning. RRI provides this missing layer through three components: the Rose-Frame, which identifies likely breakdowns in reasoning; the Architect's Pen, which introduces targeted reflection steps at critical moments; and an inference-time workflow that embeds these steps without retraining the model. Together, these elements transform human-AI interaction into a joint reasoning system with explicit checkpoints, conflict surfacing, and an auditable trail of assumptions. Rather than making machines think like humans or forcing humans to reason like machines, RRI creates a structured interaction in which both compensate for each other's limitations. It reframes AI safety as a cognitive architecture problem, where reliable decisions depend on embedding reflection directly into the interaction process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"关系性反思智能"（Relational Reflective Intelligence, RRI），一个推理时治理层，通过可审计的推理循环将反思操作化，使人类与LLM的交互转变为具有显式检查点、冲突暴露和可审计假设轨迹的联合推理系统。
AI.motivation: LLM虽然提升了信息获取效率，但其流畅性绕过了缓慢、反思性的判断过程。LLM继承了与人类相似的认知脆弱性（如依赖直觉捷径、混淆表征与现实、偏好一致性而非证伪），当人类与模型共享这些倾向时，错误会累积放大，作者将此称为"关系漂移"（relational drift）。现有方法侧重于建模词与词之间的关系，而非模型输出与人类推理之间的关系，因此需要一个交互层面的治理层来解决这一问题。
AI.method: RRI由三个核心组件构成：(1) Rose-Frame，用于识别推理中可能的崩溃点；(2) Architect's Pen，在关键时刻引入有针对性的反思步骤；(3) 推理时工作流，将这些反思步骤嵌入模型交互过程中而无需重新训练模型。整体方法将AI安全重新定义为认知架构问题，强调将反思直接嵌入交互过程。
AI.result: 论文为概念性与框架性贡献，提出RRI作为一种新的推理时治理范式，使其围绕LLM运行而非嵌入LLM内部。它将人机交互转化为联合推理系统，提供显式检查点、冲突暴露机制以及可审计的假设轨迹，使人类与AI能够相互弥补各自的局限性。
AI.conclusion: RRI不是让机器像人类一样思考，也不是强迫人类像机器一样推理，而是创建一种结构化交互，使双方能够补偿彼此的局限性。它将AI安全重新定义为认知架构问题，强调可靠决策依赖于将反思直接嵌入交互过程，从而在人类与LLM之间实现稳定、可审计的推理。

title: PoQ-Judge: A Multi-Architecture Evaluation Framework for Cost-Aware Proof-of-Quality in Decentralized LLM Inference
summary: Decentralized LLM inference networks need lightweight, reference-free quality evaluation for Proof of Quality (PoQ). We present PoQ-Judge, a framework that trains dedicated judge models to score query-output pairs without ground-truth references. We study three architectures across the quality-cost tradeoff: a TextCNN judge, a MiniLM cross-encoder, and a DeBERTa judge. Using two-stage training on UltraFeedback plus GPT-labeled in-domain data, the best model reaches 0.747 Pearson correlation with the ground-truth proxy on a held-out test set, outperforming reference-based evaluators from prior work. As a reference-free component in composite scoring, it achieves 0.645 Pearson correlation, matching the best single reference-based evaluator while removing the need for reference answers. We also show that online calibration identifies semantic quality as the dominant dimension and that cascade evaluation reduces cost by 72.7 percent with only modest quality loss. Results are much stronger on QA than summarization, pointing to proxy quality as the main remaining limitation.

AI.tldr: PoQ-Judge 是一个面向去中心化 LLM 推理网络的多架构参考自由（reference-free）质量评估框架。它训练了三种轻量级判别模型（TextCNN 10M、MiniLM 22M、DeBERTa 184M），通过两阶段训练流程（UltraFeedback 预训练 + GPT 标注领域数据微调），在无参考答案条件下实现高质量评分，其中 DeBERTa 判别器在 300 样本测试集上达到 0.747 Pearson 相关系数，超越了所有基于参考答案的基线评估器。
AI.motivation: 去中心化 LLM 推理网络需要在无参考答案（reference）的情况下进行轻量级质量评估以支持 PoQ（Proof of Quality）激励机制。此前多维质量评分框架中的最强信号（语义相似度）依赖参考答案，在实际部署中无法获取；而现有的 NLI 跨编码器、LLM-as-a-Judge 等无参考评估器存在性能差或延迟高的问题，存在"参考自由评估缺口"。本文旨在通过训练专用轻量级判别器弥合这一缺口。
AI.method: 设计三种覆盖质量-成本 Pareto 前沿的判别架构：(1) TextCNN 判别器（~10M 参数，亚毫秒延迟）使用多核 1D 卷积 + 最大池化；(2) MiniLM 跨编码器判别器（22M 参数）基于蒸馏 Transformer；(3) DeBERTa-v3 判别器（184M 参数）使用解耦注意力机制。三者均通过两阶段训练：先在 UltraFeedback（45k 样本）上预训练 MSE 回归，再在 GPT-4o-mini 标注的领域数据（1,400 训练/300 验证/300 测试，含 QA 和摘要任务）上微调。集成方面，将判别器作为参考自由维度加入多维复合评分框架；提出三种在线维度校准策略（EMA、UCB bandit、梯度下降）；设计三层级联评估协议（结构层→轻量判别层→完整评估层）实现成本感知早停。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) DeBERTa 判别器在测试集上达到 Pearson 0.747（95% CI [0.663, 0.816]），超越所有基于参考答案的基线（最佳 STS-stsb 为 0.647）；(2) 参考自由复合评分模式达到 Pearson 0.645，与最强单一基于参考的评估器在统计上无显著差异；(3) 梯度校准正确识别语义质量为主导维度（权重 4.7×初始值），并自动抑制负相关维度；(4) 级联评估在低预算（B≤0.10）下实现 72.7% 成本节省，质量仅适度下降；(5) 任务依赖显著——QA 任务 Pearson 达 0.830，摘要任务仅 0.199，主要原因是 token-level F1 对摘要任务的代理质量不足；(6) TextCNN 在亚毫秒延迟下提供 Pearson 0.472，可作为低成本筛选层级。
AI.conclusion: PoQ-Judge 证明参考自由的质量评估在 PoQ 部署中可行：紧凑编码器经专门训练后可在无参考答案条件下达到与参考依赖方法相当的评估效果。去中心化部署不再需要维护参考答案数据库。该框架包含完整的质量-成本 Pareto 设计、在线校准机制和级联协议，与作者此前成本感知 PoQ、对抗鲁棒性和多维评分工作一起构成完整的去中心化 LLM 推理质量测量-激励分配流水线。主要限制包括：token-level F1 对摘要任务代理质量差、GPT 标注数据引入教师模型偏差、测试集规模有限（n=300）、单领域实验未覆盖代码生成等任务、判别器自身的对抗鲁棒性未评估。未来工作包括改进任务特定 GT 代理、自适应架构选择、判别器对抗防御及 Sybil 抵抗身份机制集成。

title: The Structural Attention Tax: How Retrieval Format Hijacks In-Context Learning Independent of Content
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems inject external knowledge to improve LLM outputs, yet the format of injected content -- distinct from its semantic relevance -- can independently distort the model's attention distribution. We identify and formalise a phenomenon we term the structural attention tax: knowledge graph (KG) triples, due to their relational delimiters and repeated slot patterns, capture 2-3x more attention per token than semantically equivalent natural-language text ($\hat{o}$(KG) $\approx$ 0.70 vs. $\hat{o}$(neutral) $\approx$ 0.25), compressing demonstration attention by up to 42% -- regardless of whether the triples are relevant or noise. We develop a formal framework decomposing attention scores into semantic and structural components (Eq. 2), derive a compression bound (Proposition 1) connecting token-level format bias to demonstration attention loss, and show that the structural term governs how much attention is diverted while the semantic term governs whether this helps or hurts. This decoupling reveals two orthogonal axes for improving retrieval-augmented ICL: optimising retrieval quality (semantic axis) and reducing format-driven attention capture (structural axis). Empirically, across two model families (Mistral-7B, LLaMA-3-8B) and three QA benchmarks, we observe that source-task alignment dominates: task-matched BM25 retrieval achieves 58-62% on HotpotQA vs. ConceptNet's 25-27%, a >30 pp gap that dwarfs all gating strategies ($\leq$2 pp). We derive five structure-aware mitigation strategies from the framework, ranging from zero-cost prompt modifications to training-time regularisation; format flattening (S3) is validated by both accuracy and attention-level evidence from a verbalized-triple control, while structural dispersal (S1) yields mixed results that illuminate the challenges of format-level intervention.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"结构性注意力税"（Structural Attention Tax）概念，指出在RAG系统中，知识图谱三元组因其关系定界符和重复槽位模式，会独立于语义内容地"劫持"LLM注意力——每个token捕获的注意力是等义自然语言的2-3倍，导致演示示例注意力被压缩高达42%。论文将注意力分解为语义和结构两个正交分量，并基于此推导出五种缓解策略。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG研究主要关注"检索什么"（语义相关性），而忽略了"检索内容以何种格式呈现"对注意力分配的独立影响。作者旨在揭示一种被忽视的、与内容无关的、由格式驱动的注意力偏置机制。
AI.method: 1. 理论框架：将注意力分数分解为语义分量和结构分量（λ·σ(K)），推导展示压缩下界（命题1）。2. 七条件实验设计（C1-C7），隔离结构税与语义效应。3. 在Mistral-7B和LLaMA-3-8B两个模型上，对CommonsenseQA、HotpotQA、TriviaQA三个QA基准进行测试（n=200/1000），4-bit量化、贪心解码。4. 关键对比：相关KG三元组（C2）vs 噪声KG三元组（C3）vs 中性文本（C5），以及BM25维基百科检索（C7）vs ConceptNet检索。5. 推导五种结构感知缓解策略（S1-S5）。
AI.result: 1. 格式不变性：KG三元组无论相关与否均吸收相似注意力（C2与C3注意力率接近），证实结构税与内容无关。2. 量化结果：σ̂(KG)≈0.70 vs σ̂(neutral)≈0.25，演示注意力压缩达42%。3. 源-任务对齐主导：HotpotQA上BM25检索达58-62%，远超ConceptNet的25-27%，差距>30pp，远超门控策略的≤2pp改善。4. 置信度调节：高置信任务（CSQA）上KG注入可能有害，低置信任务（HotpotQA）上有益。5. 缓解策略验证：格式扁平化（S3）有效降低17-29% KG注意力并保持准确率；结构分散化（S1）效果模型相关且可能导致准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: 论文将"结构性注意力税"形式化为一个独立于内容质量的格式驱动机制。注意力竞争可分解为两个正交轴：语义轴（决定是否有帮助）和结构轴（决定注意力被征多少）。主要发现：(1)源-任务对齐的语义轴贡献远超门控策略（>30pp vs ≤2pp）；(2)结构税可测量且真实存在，KG与中性文本注意力捕获比约3:1；(3)格式扁平化是有效的零成本干预，结构分散化则因可能引入新注意力锚点而效果不佳。该框架为RAG系统设计提供了除检索质量之外的新的正交优化维度，未来需因果干预验证并推广至其他结构化格式（SQL、JSON、代码块）。

title: NightFeats @ MMU-RAGent NeurIPS 2025: A Context-Optimized Multi-Agent RAG System for the Text-to-Text Track
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. NeurIPS 2025 Competition Track (MMU-RAGent). System developed October 2025
summary: We present NightFeats, a structured multi-agent retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system submitted to the MMU-RAGent competition at NeurIPS 2025, where it was awarded Best Dynamic Evaluation in the text-to-text track. Rather than targeting benchmark maximization, this work proposes a principled pipeline that decomposes knowledge synthesis into three coordinated phases: retrieval, curation, and composition, each governed by explicit intermediate representations and handoff contracts. Inspired by Agentic Context Engineering (ACE), the system introduces temporal-semantic reranking, bounded contradiction reconciliation, and citation-preserving composition as core architectural primitives. Competition results show that NightFeats surpasses proprietary baselines including Claude-SonnetV2 and Nova-Pro on LLM-as-a-Judge and Human Likert evaluations, confirming that architectural transparency and verifiable evidence grounding are better aligned with human preferences than systems optimizing narrowly for automatic similarity metrics.

AI.tldr: NightFeats 是一种用于 MMU-RAGent 竞赛 (NeurIPS 2025) 的结构化多智能体检索增强生成 (RAG) 系统，采用三阶段流水线 (检索、策展、合成) 并显式定义中间表示与交接契约，凭借架构透明度和可验证的证据基础，在人类偏好评估中超越 Claude-SonnetV2 和 Nova-Pro 等基线。
AI.motivation: 传统 RAG 系统往往针对自动相似度指标进行狭窄优化，忽视架构透明性、证据可验证性与人类偏好对齐。该工作旨在提出一个以原则化、可审计的流水线替代基准最大化的设计理念，强调可解释中间表示与协调交接的重要性。
AI.method: 提出 NightFeats 框架，将知识合成解耦为三个协同阶段：1) 检索 (Retrieval)；2) 策展 (Curation)；3) 合成 (Composition)。每阶段由显式中间表示和交接契约 (handoff contracts) 管控。受 Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) 启发，引入三大架构原语：a) 时序-语义重排序 (temporal-semantic reranking)；b) 有界矛盾调和 (bounded contradiction reconciliation)；c) 引用保留式合成 (citation-preserving composition)。整体为多智能体结构化 RAG 系统。
AI.result: 在 MMU-RAGent 竞赛 (NeurIPS 2025) 文本到文本赛道中，NightFeats 获得 "Best Dynamic Evaluation" 奖项。在 LLM-as-a-Judge 和人类 Likert 评估上，其表现优于 Claude-SonnetV2 和 Nova-Pro 等专有基线模型，验证了架构透明性和可验证证据基础比单纯优化自动相似度指标更符合人类偏好。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将 RAG 系统建模为具有显式中间表示、交接契约及核心架构原语的结构化多智能体流水线，能够在动态评估和人类主观评估中取得领先表现。该工作挑战了以自动指标为唯一优化目标的范式，强调可解释性、可审计性和证据可信度在真实检索增强生成任务中的核心价值。

title: To Intervene or Not: Guiding Inference-time Alignment with Probabilistic Model Blending
summary: The wide deployment of LLMs has made model alignment necessary to make newly trained models safely and effectively respond to user instructions. Among different methods, inference-time alignment is often cheaper as it intervenes (i.e., offers guidances) only during output generation. Existing proposals apply guidances extracted from certain aligned models without properly assessing their reliability. Nonetheless, our systematic evaluation reveals that guidance effectiveness varies drastically across models; since ineffective guidances lead to further confusion and thus further interventions, the resulting excessive interventions typically indicate poor performance. To make interventions more effective and thus more efficient, we introduce BlendIn, an inference-time alignment framework that shifts from binary decisions to creating hybrid distributions integrating both models' knowledge. BlendIn stabilizes inference-time alignment by performing quality-aware alignment and proportionally weighting each model's contribution based on reliability. Compared with existing works, it preserves beneficial guidance while downweighting unreliable suggestions. BlendIn provides both diagnostic signals and mitigation strategies for misaligned guidance, achieving consistent and up to 50% performance improvement on challenging model pairs. Our code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BlendIn 框架,针对推理时对齐(inference-time alignment)中的"质量盲视"问题,将二元接受/拒绝决策转变为基于概率分布混合的软集成方法,通过自适应权重整合基础模型与引导模型的知识,在高干预率困难模型对上实现最高 50% 的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时对齐方法(如 NUDGING、IVG、InferAligner)隐含假设所有引导都是有利的,缺乏对引导质量的评估机制。系统性实验揭示了"干预悖论":引导干预率过高时性能反而下降,表明现有方法存在质量盲视问题——无法区分有益引导与有害引导,导致级联失败。在 9 个模型、6 个基准测试中,引导有效性在不同模型对之间差异巨大,严重阻碍了推理时对齐的实用部署。
AI.method: BlendIn 采用质量感知的分布混合策略。在基础模型不确定位置(max prob < τ,默认 τ=0.4),查询基础模型与引导模型的全词表概率分布,按自适应权重 α 进行线性混合:p_blend = α·p_guidance + (1-α)·p_base。混合权重 α 基于两模型置信度比与 token 级一致性计算:α = clip(p̂_g/(p̂_b + p̂_g) + λ·P_b(t_g), 0, 1),其中 λ=0.1 为一致性奖励权重。最终从混合分布中贪心选择概率最高的 token,实现两模型知识的比例化整合而非二元决策。
AI.result: 在 Llama、Gemma、Qwen 三大模型族的 9 个模型和 GSM8K、TruthfulQA、XSTest 等 6 个基准上的实验表明:BlendIn 在高干预率困难模型对(如 Qwen→Llama,干预率 22-34%)上实现一致且最高 50% 的性能提升;在低干预率模型对上保持稳定性能不出现退化;干预率上限(15%)等朴素解决方案在各模型对上均出现性能下降(0.67→0.58 等),验证了质量评估机制而非数量限制的必要性;全测试集验证也证实了方法在高干预场景的有效性,虽然单次提升幅度适中(+0-4%)。
AI.conclusion: BlendIn 将推理时对齐从"经验性有效但难以预测"转变为"具备原则性诊断信号与有效缓解策略"的方法。干预率可作为快速诊断信号识别模型不兼容性;分布混合作为软集成机制,在保留有益引导的同时降低不可靠建议的影响。该工作为开发更可靠的跨模型推理时对齐方法奠定了基础,但仍需逐对经验验证,无法完全替代微调对齐。

title: Dual-Stance Evaluation of Sycophancy: The Structure of Agreement and the Limits of Intervention
summary: Activation steering can shift LLM behaviour, but standard evaluations do not typically test whether a sycophancy-reduction direction also suppresses agreement with factually correct statements. We introduce dual-stance evaluation, which tests both stances of each topic, and apply it to centroid-difference steering on Llama-3-8B-Instruct. We find a dissociation: the model represents sycophantic and factual agreement in geometrically distinct subspaces, yet the steering direction projects equally onto both and cannot differentially target either. The direction accordingly reduces agreement with factually correct statements (e.g. that the Earth is round) as well as sycophantic ones. All other static properties of the two activation groups are matched, suggesting the behavioural dissociation arises from generation dynamics or from finer-grained structure that residual-stream analysis cannot resolve. The pattern illustrates a general gap: representations that are readable from activations may not be writable through them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"双立场评估"（Dual-Stance Evaluation）方法，用于检验激活引导（activation steering）干预是否具有非预期的副作用。研究以 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 为对象，发现通过质心差（centroid-difference）方法计算的"减少谄媚"方向不仅降低对错误立场的同意，也同样降低对事实正确立场的同意（如"地球是圆的"），表明该方向编码的是一般性的"同意极性"信号而非特异性的谄媚信号。然而，这种非特异性具有高度结构化特征：谄媚性话题的引导易感性远高于事实性话题（89% vs 14% 降幅），且这种差异可由"双立场一致性"行为指标连续预测（r=0.88 样本内，r=0.84 样本外）。子空间分析显示，两类同意在激活空间中占据几何上可区分的子空间，但引导方向对二者投影几乎相等，揭示出"可读性不等于可写性"的根本性差距。
AI.motivation: 激活引导（activation steering）是修改 LLM 行为的常用技术，但标准评估方法仅测量目标行为是否下降，而忽视干预是否同时抑制了本应保留的行为——特别是减少谄媚的引导方向是否也会减少对事实正确陈述的认同。这一盲点在安全部署中具有现实风险，因为近期研究表明表面"安全中性"的引导向量可能系统性改变越狱成功率。论文旨在通过引入对比式评估框架，揭示现有单立场评估无法检测的副作用。
AI.method: 1) 设计双立场范式：对每个话题同时测试相反的两个立场，区分谄媚性话题（两立场高同意）、有意见话题（立场间高分歧）和混合型；2) 构建 50 个项目（25 个话题，4 类内容），并在 12 个新话题上做样本外验证；3) 使用"随意朋友"提示框架进行 20 次温度采样（T=0.9）；4) 在 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 的第 8 层提取残差流激活，计算质心差引导方向 $\mathbf{v}_{\text{resist}}$；5) 扫描 $\alpha \in \{0, 0.25, ..., 4.0\}$ 进行引导强度消融；6) 子空间分析：计算两类同意激活的 Grassmann 相似度、主成分角度，以及引导方向在子空间上的投影；7) 提示变体实验：在中性框架和专家框架下测试非特异性是否依赖"随意朋友"框架；8) 响应解析采用三阶段方法，验证准确率 >97%。
AI.result: 1) 基线分类：7 个话题为经验性谄媚（基线同意率 93.2%），6 个硬事实话题为有意见（接受正确立场、拒绝错误立场）；2) 引导非特异性：对称观点两立场同意率分别下降 92% 和 75%，硬事实正确立场同意率下降 20%（如"地球是圆的"），证明质心差方向编码的是一般性不同意信号而非特异性谄媚信号；3) 引导易感性的连续可预测性：双立场一致性与引导效果呈强相关（r=0.88 样本内，r=0.84 样本外）；4) 子空间分析：两类同意的 Grassmann 相似度仅 0.15-0.20（远低于随机分割的 0.317，z=-7.86），但引导方向在两子空间上投影比例接近 1:1（ratio=0.94）；5) 所有其他静态属性（激活范数、跨层质心稳定性、组内方差、子空间跨深度区分度）均匹配；6) 提示依赖性：非特异性在随意框架下被部分抑制（硬事实正确立场仅降 3%），而在中性框架下放大至 30%，表明"随意"语境充当了锚定角色。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出双立场评估作为一种低成本、特异性审计方法，揭示了激活引导在单立场评估下被忽视的非特异性问题。核心发现是谄媚性与事实性同意在激活空间中是几何可区分的（即"可读"），但残差流层面的简单加性干预无法差异性地针对二者（即"不可写"）。75% 的行为解离无法由任何测量的静态几何属性解释，暗示差异可能源于扰动在自回归生成过程中的传播动力学，或更细粒度结构（如稀疏注意力头）被残差流聚合所稀释。这一研究在方法论层面指出：仅测量预期效应的评估方法存在结构性盲点，建议将对比式特异性审计作为引导干预部署前的标准实践。其局限性包括：单模型、单一引导方法、单一目标行为，且更复杂的引导方法（优化方向、SAE 特征、对比微调）是否能在双立场评估下通过特异性测试仍是开放问题。

title: BioDivergence: A Benchmark and Evaluation Framework for Hidden Contextual Contradictions in Biomedical Abstracts
summary: Biomedical findings often seem to conflict across studies, but many of these differences are context-dependent rather than true contradictions. Variations in cohort, geography, assay protocol, disease subtype, and clinical setting can make both claims locally valid. Existing NLI and scientific claim-verification benchmarks reduce such cases to entailment, contradiction, or neutral, failing to capture the contextual structure behind divergence. To address this, we introduce BioDivergence, an evaluation framework with a six-class conflict taxonomy, a 13-axis divergence ontology, and four structured outputs per claim pair: conflict type, divergence axes, dominant confounder, and reconciliation explanation. We release BioDivergence-Silver-v1.0, an article-disjoint silver benchmark of 11,865 claim pairs across five biomedical domains, alongside a legacy deduplicated variant for comparison. Results show notable ranking differences between the two variants, with the fine-tuned reference model dropping about 12 points under the article-disjoint setting, while Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 achieves 0.5523 accuracy and 0.3894 contextual-F1 on the 842-example primary test set. BioDivergence offers a more faithful way to distinguish contextual divergence from direct contradiction and to separate article-level memorization from genuine task learning.

AI.tldr: BioDivergence是一个面向生物医学文献的"隐藏语境矛盾"评估框架与基准,包含六类冲突分类法、13轴发散本体及四种结构化输出(冲突类型、发散轴、主导混杂因素、和解解释)。作者发布了包含11,865个声明对的文章不重叠(article-disjoint)银标准基准BioDivergence-Silver-v1.0,通过文章级泄漏审计证明:成对去重包装下微调模型的情境-矛盾F1虚高约12分。
AI.motivation: 现有NLI和科学声明验证基准(FEVER、VitaminC、SciFact、ConflictBank等)将生物医学发现压缩为"蕴含/矛盾/中性"或粗粒度冲突标签,无法区分真正的逻辑不一致与由队列、地理、检测方案、疾病亚型、临床环境等隐含语境差异导致的"局部有效"分歧。这种扁平化处理夸大了文献中的分歧,掩盖了下游生物医学NLP系统所需的关键能力——恢复"为什么"两个发现存在分歧的语境结构。
AI.method: 采用六阶段构建流水线:语料收集(PubMed与Europe PMC,202,180篇去重摘要)→规范化→基于规则声明抽取(527,907条)→候选对挖掘(嵌入检索+不一致感知排序,50,000对)→LLM银标准标注(qwen2.5:7b,带本体约束与验证/修复逻辑)→基准打包。文章不重叠主版本(10,183/840/842)与遗留成对去重版本(8,750/1,250/2,500)并存。方法上,任务1-3(冲突类型、发散轴、主导混杂因素)使用BiomedBERT编码器+多头交叉注意力+多任务预测头的判别式参考模型(损失权重λ_ct=1.0, λ_ax=1.0, λ_dc=0.3);任务4-5(和解解释、证据片段抽取)采用零样本LLM结构化生成。评估包括:多数类/分层随机词法基线、零样本NLI迁移、Qwen3-8B与Mistral-7B-v0.3等指令调优LLM,以及与非Qwen标注家族的敏感度审计。
AI.result: 主发布结果(文章不重叠,3种子平均):参考模型准确率0.693, Macro-F1 0.253, 加权F1 0.695, κ 0.276, 情境矛盾Ctx F1 0.401±0.017;Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3零样本全842例测试:准确率0.5523, Ctx F1 0.3894。遗留成对级别参考模型Ctx F1为0.521,主版本下下降约12点,归因于文章级重叠。零样本NLI迁移在该任务上几乎完全失败。9轴主发散轴评估下Micro-F1 0.195, Macro-F1 0.168, Exact Match 0.623。消融实验表明多任务学习是核心设计(去除后轴Micro-F1从0.215降至0.069,主导混杂因素准确率从0.561降至0.133);交叉注意力对混杂因素预测贡献最大(0.561→0.533)。v1.0仅可靠支持6类冲突中的2类(no_conflict与contextual_contradiction)与13轴中的9轴。主导混杂因素在金标轴输入下可升至0.6901,说明其上限于轴预测质量。
AI.conclusion: BioDivergence提供了一个泄漏感知的评估视角,能将文章级记忆与情境推理能力分离。文章不重叠评估揭示了成对去重包装中约12点的虚高分,这是传统基准无法暴露的。该基准的银标准标签、本体覆盖度(直接矛盾n=7,证据不足n=0等稀疏类)与单家族(Qwen)标注偏差被明确披露;v1.1计划引入多标注人带摘要上下文的标注流程以提升稀疏类支持。基准的核心价值不在于单一分数,而在于以结构化多输出形式评估"为什么"分歧的能力。

title: ProcessThinker: Enhancing Multi-modal Large Language Models Reasoning via Rollout-based Process Reward
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Logical Reasoning of Large Language Models. 7 pages, 1 figure
summary: Visual question answering increasingly requires multi-step reasoning. Recent post-training with reinforcement learning under verifiable rewards (RLVR) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) can improve multimodal reasoning, but most approaches rely on sparse outcome-only rewards. As a result, they struggle to tell whether an incorrect answer comes from a small mistake late in the reasoning or from an unhelpful trajectory from the start. A common solution is to train a process reward model (PRM) for step-level supervision, but this typically requires large-scale high-quality chain-of-thought annotations and additional training cost. We propose ProcessThinker, a practical post-training pipeline that provides step-level process rewards without training an explicit PRM. ProcessThinker first rewrites reasoning traces into a step-tagged format for cold-start supervised fine-tuning, then applies GRPO with a standard format reward and our rollout-based process reward. Concretely, for each intermediate step, we sample multiple continuations from that step and use the empirical success rate (final-answer verification) as the step reward. This gives dense credit assignment and encourages reasoning steps that more reliably support a correct conclusion, helping reduce inconsistent or self-contradictory progress across steps -- a key issue in logical reasoning. Across four challenging video benchmarks (Video-MMMU, MMVU, VideoMathQA, and LongVideoBench), ProcessThinker consistently improves over the baseline model Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct

AI.tldr: ProcessThinker 是一种针对多模态大语言模型的后训练流水线，通过基于采样的过程奖励（rollout-based process reward）在 GRPO 框架中实现无需显式训练过程奖励模型（PRM）的步骤级信用分配。该方法在四个视频推理基准上持续提升 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有的 GRPO 类 RLVR 方法在多模态多步推理中仅使用稀疏的最终答案奖励，无法区分错误是来自推理末尾的小失误还是初始轨迹的根本性偏差。传统过程奖励模型（PRM）虽然能提供步骤级监督，但需要大量高质量 CoT 标注和额外训练成本。核心问题是：能否在不训练独立 PRM 的情况下获得鼓励推理一致性更强的步骤级训练信号？
AI.method: 两阶段后训练流水线：（1）SFT 冷启动——用更强的教师模型（Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct）将 Video-R1-CoT-165k 推理轨迹改写为带 step-tag 的结构化格式，并经过二轮过滤筛选出 19k 样本对 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 进行微调；（2）GRPO 强化学习——核心创新是基于 rollout 的过程奖励：对每个中间步骤前缀 p_i，从当前策略 π_θ 采样 M=4 个续写，用最终答案验证的经验成功率 c_i 作为该步的过程分数，轨迹级过程奖励取前缀可解性的平均（R_proc），并设定 K_max=6。结合格式奖励、有界步骤奖励 B(K)（平方根裁剪）和惩罚门控（τ=0.5），最终奖励加权和为 r = r_fmt + λ_acc·R̄_acc + λ_proc·R̄_proc + B(K)，其中 λ_acc + λ_proc = 1。
AI.result: 在 Video-MMMU、MMVU、VideoMathQA、LongVideoBench 四个视频推理基准上，ProcessThinker（process-only，λ_proc=1）将 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct 的平均准确率从 56.30% 提升至 59.72%（+3.42），其中 VideoMathQA 提升最大（+6.47），LongVideoBench 提升 +3.90。Process-only 优于 outcome-only 和平衡混合，证明过程奖励比稀疏结果奖励提供更密集的监督信号。SFT 单独使用反而会降低基线表现，说明结构化格式主要教会"如何书写"，而非直接优化任务成功。Video-R1-7B 因使用旧版 Qwen2.5-VL 骨干不可直接比较。
AI.conclusion: ProcessThinker 证明可通过 rollout 成功率（continuation solvability）从稀疏可验证结果中提取步骤级信用分配，无需训练独立 PRM。该 rollout 过程奖励鼓励更可靠地支持正确结论的中间步骤，缓解多步逻辑推理中步骤间不一致或自相矛盾的问题。结合严格格式约束和 GRPO 式 RLVR，在四个视频推理基准上稳定提升基线，且强调过程奖励时增益最大。主要局限是效率——continuation solvability 需要每步多次 rollout，额外推理成本可能抵消使用较少数据带来的收益，且奖励对 rollout 随机性和步骤切分敏感。

title: T2MM: An LLM Supported Architecture For Inquiry-Based Modeling
summary: Model Construction is a foundational practice in science learning that relies on visualization and interactivity. Large Language Models, increasingly augmented with multimodal capabilities, have been integrated in education contexts to support learning. However, these tools lack visual interactivity that is required by some learning contexts. We introduce Text to Multimodal Model (T2MM), a robust, dynamic LLM supported architecture that assists in model construction within the open inquiry ecology-based modeling software Virtual Experimental Research Assistant (VERA). T2MM accounts for the current context of the learner's model and creates interactive models, rather than static images, enabling the model to remain responsive to manual adjustment. To measure technical feasibility, we evaluate T2MM through a custom procedurally generated dataset of natural language learner modeling requests and target models within the VERA system. T2MM outperforms a baseline model generation architecture implemented through LLM-supported full code generation, common in the literature, across all measured success metrics. Our contribution not only outlines LLM integration into a inquiry-based learning modeling tool, but also describes a possible architecture through which more interactive multimodal LLM tools can be created.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了T2MM（Text to Multimodal Model）架构，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的行动序列驱动框架，用于在生态建模软件VERA中支持探究式科学学习中的交互式模型构建。T2MM通过将学习者当前模型的XML转化为JSON，发送给LLM生成结构化动作序列（如创建/删除节点、编辑关系），再通过API在VERA中执行，从而生成可交互、可持续调整的动态模型，而非静态图像。在975个程序生成的自然语言请求-目标模型对的数据集上评估，T2MM在XML编译成功率（100%）、图编辑距离、请求长度和请求类型等所有指标上均优于基于0-Shot和N-Shot的完整XML代码生成基线方法。
AI.motivation: 科学教育中的模型构建是探究式学习的核心实践，需要可视化和交互性。现有的多模态LLM教育工具要么缺乏多步交互能力，要么存在技术可靠性问题（如自动数学绘图系统在迭代建模上存在局限），因此LLM在科学学习和探究式学习中的整合仍主要依赖纯文本交互。模型构建需要基于"探究循环"进行多步迭代，这对现有LLM架构提出了独特挑战。
AI.method: T2MM架构包含三个核心组件：(1) VERA系统——基于生态本体的概念建模与仿真软件，使用MxGraph构建模型并编译为NetLogo后端；(2) T2MM中间层——包括模型XML检索器、XML到JSON转换器、LLM请求器（使用GPT-4.1-mini，结合JSON模型状态、学习者请求和本体提示生成动作序列）、动作序列解析器（通过本体验证器确保动作符合VERA本体约束）以及VERA API调用器；(3) LLM系统。关键设计是将完整XML生成替换为LLM生成紧凑的动作序列（如addNode、remove_relationship等），并将其映射到后端API方法。数据集由5个专家XML模型程序化生成975个自然语言请求-目标模型对，涵盖节点/关系创建删除和参数调整三类操作。评估采用四个指标：XML编译成功率、图编辑距离、动作序列长度下的成功率、按请求类型（创建/编辑/改参数）的成功率。
AI.result: T2MM在所有指标上均优于基线：XML编译成功率100%（0-Shot 96.62%，N-Shot 99.69%）；图编辑距离均值0.298，远低于0-Shot的1.638和N-Shot的3.572（N-Shot最差情况下需42次编辑，且对参数值有随机修改问题）；在目标动作序列长度上，T2MM在5个动作内成功率接近100%，7个动作时约50%，而两种基线方法在3个动作后性能急剧下降；在请求类型上，0-Shot从空画布创建模型的成功率为0%，N-Shot仅8.31%，而T2MM在编辑和改参数任务上准确率较高。失败案例主要出现在创建模型时（79.38%），但仍显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: T2MM是首个在AI与教育领域使用LLM生成动作序列（基于学习者实时模型状态）来支持交互式概念建模的架构。其核心优势在于：(1) 采用"行动聚焦"而非"结果聚焦"策略——接收需要执行的动作而非完整输出，显著减少幻觉和不一致；(2) 使用紧凑JSON表示代替冗长XML，降低生成错误概率；(3) 动作序列经本体验证后通过API执行，确保模型符合VERA本体。该架构为科学学习环境中可信赖的LLM辅助建模提供了可行路径，同时为其他交互式多模态LLM工具的设计提供了通用参考。局限在于架构对VERA本体的依赖性，泛化能力待验证；当前评估仅基于程序化数据集和模型结构正确性，未涉及真实学习者请求、视觉表示评估和定性分析，这些留作未来工作。

title: Calibration Drift Under Reasoning: How Chain-of-Thought Budgets Induce Overconfidence in Large Language Models
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Introduces Calibration Drift Under Reasoning (CDUR) with theoretical analysis and preliminary experiments; includes CABStop; code and data available
summary: The ability of large language models (LLMs) to express calibrated uncertainty is important for safe deployment. Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely used to improve accuracy and reliability, but its effect on calibration is not fully understood. We show that this picture is incomplete: in some settings, increasing the reasoning budget beyond a task-specific threshold can cause models to become systematically overconfident, assigning high confidence to incorrect answers. We call this phenomenon Calibration Drift Under Reasoning (CDUR) and study it both theoretically and empirically. We define reasoning budget B and analyze conditions under which Expected Calibration Error ECE(B) follows a non-monotonic pattern: it first decreases as reasoning corrects errors, then increases as longer reasoning produces internally consistent but incorrect explanations. We propose a Hypothesis Lock-In model based on autoregressive generation to explain this behavior. We evaluate Llama-3.1-8B and Llama-3.3-70B on 47 reasoning-trap questions across four reasoning budgets and three seeds (1,368 API calls; 574 valid responses). The 8B model shows non-monotonic calibration behavior, while results for the 70B model are limited to baseline evaluation and are inconclusive for budget-dependent effects. We introduce CABStop, a calibration-aware stopping rule that halts reasoning when confidence diverges from an auxiliary accuracy estimate. These results suggest that increasing reasoning depth does not always improve reliability and should be monitored carefully.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"推理下的校准漂移"(Calibration Drift Under Reasoning, CDUR)现象,指出链式思维(CoT)推理预算超过任务特定阈值时,大语言模型(LLM)会系统性地变得过度自信——即对错误答案赋予高置信度。作者在Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-3.3-70B模型上进行了实验验证,并提出了基于最优停止理论的CABStop校准感知停止算法。
AI.motivation: 链式思维(CoT)推理被广泛认为能提高LLM的准确性和可靠性,但其对校准(calibration)的影响尚未被充分研究。准确性的提升并不必然带来校准的改善——在某些场景下,延长推理反而会让模型对错误答案表现出高置信度,这种"自信地犯错"在安全关键应用中尤为危险。因此,有必要系统研究推理预算与模型校准之间的关系。
AI.method: 1. **形式化框架**:定义推理预算B,分析预期校准误差ECE(B)关于B的非单调(U形)轨迹条件,提出三个形式化命题刻画该现象。2. **假设锁定模型(Hypothesis Lock-In Model)**:基于自回归生成,假设模型在推理开始时采样初始假设h₀,后续token以h₀为条件生成,导致内部一致性随链长增加而增强,置信度上升但正确性可能不变。3. **实验设计**:在47道推理陷阱题(覆盖21类认知陷阱)上评估Llama-3.1-8B和Llama-3.3-70B,跨4个推理预算(none/light/medium/heavy,对应0/128/512/2048 token)和3个随机种子,共1368次API调用,574个有效响应。4. **CABStop算法**:基于最优停止理论,当模型表达置信度与辅助精度估计的差值超过阈值δ时停止推理。5. **指标**:ECE(10等宽分箱)、过度自信差距OG、Wrong+Confident统计。
AI.result: **Llama-3.1-8B**:ECE呈现非单调轨迹——none(0.044±0.015)→light(0.104±0.034)→medium(0.050±0.049)→heavy(0.015±0.005),light推理时校准最差。OG在所有预算下均为正(+0.25至+0.49),heavy推理下仍存在+0.245的过度自信。准确率从none的0.461提升至heavy的0.739,但置信度上升速度不完全匹配正确性提升。**Llama-3.3-70B**:仅评估了no-reasoning条件(ECE=0.035±0.026, OG=+0.155),多预算数据缺失,无法确认或否认CDUR动态。**陷阱类别分析**:计数、集合论、空间推理类问题在wrong+confident分布中占主导。**三阶段特征化**:(I)表面纠错期(短推理有益);(II)锁定期(中间预算最危险);(III)重度推理期(长链偶尔能突破锁定但仍有过度自信)。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心结论是:推理深度与校准质量的关系并非单调,适度推理预算可能比无推理或重度推理产生更差的校准表现。CDUR现象在8B模型上得到定性支持,但70B模型因数据不完整而无法验证。作者提出的CABStop算法提供了校准感知的推理停止机制,但其有效性依赖于辅助精度估计的质量。研究存在显著局限:样本量小(47题)、有效率仅42%可能引入选择偏差、口头化置信度不等于真实认知不确定性、仅评估Llama家族。总体而言,本文为推理时的校准监控作为与准确性同等重要的关注点提供了理论框架和初步实证支持,呼吁未来在大规模、多模型家族上验证该现象。

title: From Awareness to Action: Understanding and Overcoming the Research-Practice Gap in Algorithmic Fairness for Public Health
comment: Extended version of an accepted IASEAI'26 paper; includes technical appendices. 22 pages, 2 figures
summary: Algorithmic fairness is essential for responsible ML-driven public health research, yet its practical implementation remains limited. To investigate this awareness-action gap, we conducted a sequential mixed-methods study comprising expert interviews, an online survey, and systematic mapping. The expert interviews informed the design of the survey, which in turn revealed fragmented definitions of fairness, limited training and guidance, reliance on external sources, and rare use of formal assessment, mitigation, or monitoring. These findings were subsequently mapped onto three established research-practice gap lenses: the Knowledge-Practice Gap, the Knowledge-to-Action Cycle, and the Knowing-Doing Gap, each offering complementary perspectives. Building on this synthesis, we introduce the Fairness-to-Action framework, which integrates methodological, organizational, and systemic dimensions to identify where translation of algorithmic fairness knowledge stalls. Our analysis shows that fairness remains weakly institutionalized, translation mechanisms are externally driven, and system-level priorities continue to emphasize accuracy over fairness. These insights suggest critical leverage points for advancing safe, fair, and ethical ML-driven public health research practice.

AI.tldr: 本文通过顺序混合方法研究（专家访谈+在线调查+系统映射），调查了荷兰ML驱动公共卫生研究中算法公平性的"知行差距"，揭示了公平性知识仍处于弱制度化、依赖外部渠道、系统层面仍重准确率轻公平性的现状，并提出整合方法论、组织与系统三层面的Fairness-to-Action (F2A) 框架以识别翻译障碍与杠杆点。
AI.motivation: 算法公平性在ML驱动的公共卫生研究中至关重要，但实际执行仍然有限。已有研究多基于文献评估公平性报告，缺少对研究者本身如何理解与操作化公平性的实证调查，且尚未将这一知行差距系统映射至成熟的实施科学理论。论文旨在填补这一空白，通过直接调研研究者，识别公平性知识翻译为何在公共卫生ML实践中停滞不前。
AI.method: 采用两阶段顺序探索性混合方法设计：(1) 半结构化专家访谈（4位专家，28道问题）用于工具开发与概念覆盖；(2) 横断面在线调查（Qualtrics平台，2025年2-8月，73份有效回复，覆盖荷兰ML-公共卫生界面研究者），含描述性统计、交叉表分析与主题编码；将调查发现映射到三个实施科学理论——知识-实践差距（What）、知识到行动KTA循环（How）、知行差距（Why），并在此基础上构建F2A框架。报告遵循CROSS与CHERRIES规范。
AI.result: 调查揭示了五大维度（概念化、意识、评估、设计、应用）的关键发现：(1) 公平性定义碎片化，79%报告理解程度低至中等；(2) 73%知晓框架但缺乏具体内容，70%无正式培训；(3) 偏见评估多为非正式讨论（52%），仅14%使用公平性指标，72%报告无或极少的偏见缓解；(4) 58%项目中公平性定义弱或缺失；(5) 81%无持续监测机制，但84%接受适度准确率-公平性权衡。F2A框架诊断显示：方法论层面公平性知识弱制度化，组织层面翻译机制外部驱动，系统层面准确率激励压倒公平性，存在方法论-组织-系统三层面的联动失灵。
AI.conclusion: 研究贡献在于将公平性翻译失败定位为方法论（个人化持有、弱编码）、组织（依赖外部而非内部结构）与系统（准确率激励、碎片化治理）三个相互关联层面的问题。F2A框架作为循证诊断支架而非规范性模型，识别出关键杠杆点：将公平性定义正式化为设计要求、建立内部知识管道与培训、将偏见报告与纠正行动挂钩、将激励与持续监测对齐。近期的最高影响力行动包括正式化定义、加强内部培训、链接报告与纠正。建议未来工作通过观察实践验证实施、开展案例研究、测试制度杠杆、跨国比较来推动公平性从认知走向可持续的负责任实践。

title: The Environmental Cost of LLMs in AIED: Reporting and Practices
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) usage in recent years has become increasingly widespread in the Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED) community. While LLMs offer unique avenues for learners and educators, using LLMs comes with computational and environmental costs. These costs are mostly hidden due to a lack of standardised procedures to measure and report these impacts. To address this gap, we first conducted a literature review of all papers published as part of the AIED 2025 conference proceedings, determining if and how computational or environmental costs of LLMs are reported. Most projects use LLMs, but few report computational resources used and almost none discuss environmental impacts of LLMs as an ethical concern. To address this lack of standardised reporting practices, we propose an open-source method for systematically measuring and reporting the computational expense of LLMs and environmental impact of running Machine Learning (ML) AIED systems. We provide software solutions to measure the carbon footprint for both local and cloud based hardware. We also provide an easy-to-use formula to calculate the computational expense of frontier LLMs even when the exact number of parameters is not known. Overall, we hope to motivate colleagues to use our method to strive for more transparent reporting of hidden costs of using LLMs in the AIED community.

AI.tldr: 本文针对AIED（教育人工智能）社区中LLM（大语言模型）使用所带来的计算与环境成本缺乏标准化报告的问题，对AIED 2025会议全部396篇论文进行文献综述，发现多数项目使用LLM但几乎不报告环境成本，并提出了一套开源的标准化报告方法与工具（CodeCarbon和TerraFlops）以及用于估算LLM计算成本的公式。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在AIED社区的广泛应用，训练与推理所需的计算资源带来了显著的环境影响。然而，目前AIED研究界缺乏标准化的计算与环境成本报告程序，相关讨论多聚焦于偏见、隐私和学习成效等方面，而对环境伦理的关注严重不足。该研究旨在揭示当前AIED社区对LLM环境成本报告的现状，并推动透明、统一的报告规范的形成。
AI.method: 1. 文献综述法：系统审查AIED 2025会议全部396篇论文，按LLM使用情况、类型（实验对象、数据分析、产品设计、用户交互）、计算成本报告情况、模型规格以及可持续性提及情况进行编码分析；2. 工具开发：基于开源工具CodeCarbon开发了TerraFlops包装器，引入PUE等效（Power Usage Effectiveness）等价指标，提出Corrected Carbon Intensity、Carbon per Accuracy和Sustainability Score三种综合指标；3. 理论建模：针对decoder-only transformer架构，推导出首个token及后续token的FLOPs计算公式，并给出简化近似公式FLOPs=2Nn，用于在参数未知情况下估算前沿LLM的计算成本。
AI.result: 1. 文献综述结果：396篇论文中，257篇使用了LLM（占65%），其中176篇用于用户交互（如辅导），108篇用于产品设计，100篇作为实验对象，79篇用于数据分析；但仅85篇报告了计算成本，仅57篇提及可持续性/环境问题，且报告方式高度不一致；2. 模型使用方面，OpenAI GPT-4/4o最为常见，其次是Claude、Gemini及开源的LLaMA、Mistral、Gemma、Qwen、DeepSeek等；3. TerraFlops工具能够为本地与云端硬件提供统一的可持续性指标，并通过对Iris和Breast Cancer数据集的逻辑回归训练示例展示其应用；4. 提出的LLM FLOPs估算公式能在参数未公开的情况下提供量级准确的计算成本估算，结合H100 GPU与全美电网均值可粗略估算碳排放。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出三项标准化可持续性报告建议：①使用CodeCarbon测量并报告本地或云端AIED系统的碳强度；②使用TerraFlops框架将碳排放与模型准确率共同报告，引入PUE等价概念以反映硬件利用率；③使用理论FLOPs估算来量化专有LLM的计算成本与CO2排放。研究呼吁AIED会议将可持续性指标报告作为投稿要求，类似于匿名性要求，以提升环境责任意识；同时指出未来工作需完善PUE基线、考虑云计算的水资源消耗、改进非线性准确率-碳排放关系以及建立1-10分通用可持续性评分标准。

title: Preregistration for Experiments with AI Agents
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 as a Spotlight (Top 5%) Position Paper
summary: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) and autonomous AI agents has given rise to a rapidly growing methodological paradigm: "in silico" behavioral experiments. Originally conceived as a way to use AI agents as proxies for human participants in studies of cognition, decision-making, and social dynamics, this approach has taken on new significance -- as AI agents increasingly negotiate, transact, and make consequential decisions on behalf of people and organizations, understanding their behavior has become a research priority in its own right. While these experiments with AI agents offer unprecedented advantages in terms of scalability, cost efficiency, and experimental control, they also inherit, and in some cases amplify, methodological vulnerabilities that have long plagued human subjects research. To address these issues, this paper argues that preregistration practices -- central to improving the credibility of human subjects experiments -- should now be extended to experiments with AI agents. We systematically catalog the researcher degrees of freedom that experiments with AI agents introduce -- model selection, prompt wording, settings, and outcome-contingent redesign, for example -- and show how the low cost of iteration and lack of reporting norms make these choices both easy to exploit and difficult to detect. We propose a preregistration template tailored to experiments with AI agents and call on conferences, journals, and funding agencies to make preregistration standard practice for this emerging research paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文主张将社会科学中广泛使用的预注册（preregistration）实践推广至以AI智能体为"被试"的"硅基"行为实验中。作者系统梳理了AI实验特有的研究者自由度（模型选择、提示词设计、采样参数、解析规则等），通过2,430组锚定效应模拟实验展示同一研究问题可因规范选择不同而得出截然相反的结论，并提出了一份针对AI智能体实验的预注册模板，呼吁会议、期刊与资助机构将其标准化。
AI.motivation: 动机源于三重担忧：（1）AI智能体越来越多地被作为行为实验的"被试"，并在高风险领域自主决策，理解其行为本身已成为独立的研究课题；（2）该范式继承了人因实验中研究者自由度所带来的方法论漏洞，并因提示词×模型×温度×解析规则等组合爆炸和极低的边际实验成本而进一步放大；（3）传统ML基准测试的"留出测试集"惯例不适用于行为实验（无标准测试集、提示词常为定制研究工具），存在方法论空白，若不及时干预可能重蹈心理学复制危机的覆辙。
